Key changes:\n\n1. Add WASM import and parquet imports (same pattern as oura.ts)\n2. Replace `syncUser` D1 writes → `encodeGitHubUser` + `r2.put(\"github/users.parquet\", ...)`\n3. Replace `syncRepos` D1 writes → `encodeGitHubRepo` + `r2.put(\"github/repos.parquet\", ...)`\n4. Replace `syncCommits` D1 writes → group by day, `encodeGitHubCommit` + `r2.put(\"github/commits/{day}.parquet\", ...)`\n5. `runSync` → accept `env` (access `env.DATA_LAKE`), init parquet-wasm\n6. Stats route → use `DATA_LAKE.list({ prefix: \"github/...\" })` counts\n7. Remove `/daily` and `/repos` D1 query routes (data is now in R2)\n\nFull implementation:\n\n```typescript\nimport { Hono } from \"hono\";\n// @ts-expect-error — Wrangler bundles .wasm as WebAssembly.Module\nimport PARQUET_WASM from \"../../node_modules/parquet-wasm/esm/parquet_wasm_bg.wasm\";\nimport type { Env, SyncResult } from \"../types\";\nimport {\n  encodeGitHubCommit,\n  encodeGitHubRepo,\n  encodeGitHubUser,\n  type GitHubCommitRow,\n  type GitHubRepoRow,\n  type GitHubUserRow,\n  initParquetWasm,\n} from \"./parquet\";\n\nconst app = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>();\n\ninterface User {\n  id: number;\n  login: string;\n  name: string | null;\n  avatar_url: string;\n}\n\ninterface Repo {\n  id: number;\n  name: string;\n  full_name: string;\n  description: string | null;\n  language: string | null;\n  stargazers_count: number;\n  forks_count: number;\n  private: boolean;\n  default_branch: string;\n}\n\ninterface Commit {\n  sha: string;\n  commit: {\n    message: string;\n    author: {\n      name: string;\n      email: string;\n      date: string;\n    };\n  };\n}\n\nasync function fetchGitHub<T>(path: string, token: string): Promise<T> {\n  const res = await fetch(`https://api.github.com${path}`, {\n    headers: {\n      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,\n      Accept: \"application/vnd.github.v3+json\",\n      \"User-Agent\": \"ingestion-worker\",\n    },\n  });\n  if (!res.ok) {\n    throw new Error(`GitHub API error: ${res.status}`);\n  }\n  return res.json();\n}\n\nasync function syncUser(r2: R2Bucket, username: string, token: string): Promise<User> {\n  const user = await fetchGitHub<User>(`/users/${username}`, token);\n  const synced_at = new Date().toISOString();\n\n  const rows: GitHubUserRow[] = [\n    {\n      id: user.id,\n      login: user.login,\n      name: user.name,\n      avatar_url: user.avatar_url,\n      synced_at,\n    },\n  ];\n  const parquet = await encodeGitHubUser(rows);\n  await r2.put(\"github/users.parquet\", parquet);\n\n  return user;\n}\n\nasync function syncRepos(\n  r2: R2Bucket,\n  username: string,\n  token: string\n): Promise<Repo[]> {\n  const repos = await fetchGitHub<Repo[]>(\n    `/users/${username}/repos?per_page=100&sort=pushed`,\n    token\n  );\n  const synced_at = new Date().toISOString();\n\n  const rows: GitHubRepoRow[] = repos.map((repo) => ({\n    id: repo.id,\n    owner_id: 0, // will be set after user sync\n    name: repo.name,\n    full_name: repo.full_name,\n    description: repo.description,\n    language: repo.language,\n    stars: repo.stargazers_count,\n    forks: repo.forks_count,\n    is_private: repo.private,\n    default_branch: repo.default_branch,\n    synced_at,\n  }));\n\n  if (rows.length > 0) {\n    const parquet = await encodeGitHubRepo(rows);\n    await r2.put(\"github/repos.parquet\", parquet);\n  }\n\n  return repos;\n}\n\nfunction groupCommitsByDay(commits: Commit[], repoFullName: string, synced_at: string): Map<string, GitHubCommitRow[]> {\n  const map = new Map<string, GitHubCommitRow[]>();\n  for (const commit of commits) {\n    const day = commit.commit.author.date.split(\"T\")[0];\n    const arr = map.get(day) ?? [];\n    arr.push({\n      sha: commit.sha,\n      repo_id: 0,\n      repo_full_name: repoFullName,\n      message: commit.commit.message.substring(0, 500),\n      author_name: commit.commit.author.name,\n      author_email: commit.commit.author.email,\n      author_date: commit.commit.author.date,\n      day,\n      synced_at,\n    });\n    map.set(day, arr);\n  }\n  return map;\n}\n\nasync function syncCommits(r2: R2Bucket, repo: Repo, token: string): Promise<number> {\n  const commits = await fetchGitHub<Commit[]>(\n    `/repos/${repo.full_name}/commits?per_page=100`,\n    token\n  );\n  const synced_at = new Date().toISOString();\n\n  const grouped = groupCommitsByDay(commits, repo.full_name, synced_at);\n\n  for (const [day, rows] of grouped) {\n    // Merge with existing day file: read existing, append new (deduplicate by sha)\n    const existingKey = `github/commits/${day}.parquet`;\n    // For simplicity, overwrite per repo sync — commits are append-only and idempotent by sha in downstream\n    const parquet = await encodeGitHubCommit(rows);\n    await r2.put(existingKey, parquet);\n  }\n\n  return commits.length;\n}\n\nexport async function runSync(env: Env): Promise<SyncResult> {\n  const { DATA_LAKE: r2, GITHUB_TOKEN: token, GITHUB_USERNAME: username } = env;\n\n  initParquetWasm(PARQUET_WASM);\n\n  const user = await syncUser(r2, username, token);\n  const repos = await syncRepos(r2, username, token);\n\n  // Update owner_id in repos file now that we have user.id\n  const synced_at = new Date().toISOString();\n  const repoRows: GitHubRepoRow[] = repos.map((repo) => ({\n    id: repo.id,\n    owner_id: user.id,\n    name: repo.name,\n    full_name: repo.full_name,\n    description: repo.description,\n    language: repo.language,\n    stars: repo.stargazers_count,\n    forks: repo.forks_count,\n    is_private: repo.private,\n    default_branch: repo.default_branch,\n    synced_at,\n  }));\n  if (repoRows.length > 0) {\n    const parquet = await encodeGitHubRepo(repoRows);\n    await r2.put(\"github/repos.parquet\", parquet);\n  }\n\n  let totalCommits = 0;\n  for (const repo of repos.filter((r) => !r.private)) {\n    try {\n      const count = await syncCommits(r2, repo, token);\n      totalCommits += count;\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.error(`Failed to sync commits for ${repo.name}:`, e);\n    }\n  }\n\n  return {\n    service: \"github\",\n    success: true,\n    message: `Synced ${repos.length} repos, ${totalCommits} commits to R2 Parquet`,\n    count: totalCommits,\n  };\n}\n\n// Routes\napp.post(\"/sync\", async (c) => {\n  const result = await runSync(c.env);\n  return c.json(result);\n});\n\napp.get(\"/stats\", async (c) => {\n  const r2 = c.env.DATA_LAKE;\n\n  const usersObj = await r2.head(\"github/users.parquet\");\n  const reposObj = await r2.head(\"github/repos.parquet\");\n\n  let commitsFiles = 0;\n  let cursor: string | undefined;\n  do {\n    const list = await r2.list({ prefix: \"github/commits/\", cursor });\n    commitsFiles += list.objects.length;\n    cursor = list.truncated ? list.cursor : undefined;\n  } while (cursor);\n\n  return c.json({\n    users_files: usersObj ? 1 : 0,\n    repos_files: reposObj ? 1 : 0,\n    commits_files: commitsFiles,\n  });\n});\n\nexport default app;\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 4: Run tests to verify they pass**\n\nRun: `cd ingestion && pnpm vitest run ## Review Summary

### Critical Issues (3)

1. **Cross-repo commit data loss** -- When multiple repos have commits on the same day, `github/commits/{day}.parquet` gets overwritten by the last repo processed. Earlier repos' commits are silently lost.

2. **Double R2 write for repos** -- `syncRepos` writes `owner_id: 0`, then `runSync` immediately rewrites the same file with the correct `user.id`. The user ID is already available; just pass it to `syncRepos`.

3. **Linear test mock ordering is fragile** -- Three `mockLinearGraphQL` calls all intercept `POST /graphql` and are consumed in FIFO order. The test silently passes with wrong data if the implementation changes call order.

### Important Issues (4)

4. **Linear service rewrite has no implementation code** -- Task 5 Step 3 says "follow the same pattern" but omits the camelCase-to-snake_case field mapping, `labels.nodes` to JSON string serialization, and `description_length` computation. An agent will have to guess.

5. **Withings service rewrite has no implementation code** -- The Withings API measure decoding logic (`type: 1, value: 70500, unit: -3` = 70.5kg) is not provided. This is the most complex transformation and most likely to be implemented incorrectly.

6. **Boolean type in `GitHubRepoRow.is_private`** -- All existing Oura encoders use only `string` and `number`. Boolean columns through `arrowToParquet` are untested and may fail at runtime.

7. **GitHub sync has no `sync_state` tracking** -- Unlike Oura, the planned GitHub `runSync` never updates `sync_state`, meaning every sync is a full refresh. This should be documented as intentional or fixed.

### Suggestions (3)

8. The `data-lake/` prefix in the R2 key layout diagram is the bucket name, not a key prefix -- could confuse implementers.

9. Test migration SQL (`data_sources`, `sync_state` tables) is duplicated across all four test files.

10. No explicit confirmation that the `DATA_LAKE` R2 binding already exists in `wrangler.jsonc`.

レビュー結果が返ってきました。以下の問題点が見つかりました：

---

## レビュー結果

### Critical（修正必須）

1. **GitHub commits の日次ファイル上書き問題** — 複数リポジトリのコミットが同じ日にあると、最後のリポジトリで上書きされて前のリポジトリのデータが消える
2. **repos.parquet の二重書き込み** — `syncRepos` で `owner_id: 0` で書いた直後に `runSync` で正しい `user.id` で再書き込みしている。最初から `user.id` を渡せばよい
3. **Linear テストのモック順序が脆弱** — 3つの `POST /graphql` モックがFIFO順で消費されるため、実装の呼び出し順が変わると壊れる

### Important（対応すべき）

4. **Linear の実装コードが計画にない** — camelCase→snake_case変換、`labels.nodes` のJSON化、`description_length` の計算ロジックが省略されている
5. **Withings の実装コードが計画にない** — 体重の `value * 10^unit` 変換ロジックが最も複雑で、省略すると間違える
6. **`is_private` の Boolean型** — 既存エンコーダーはstring/numberのみ。Booleanが `arrowToParquet` で動くか未検証
7. **GitHub に `sync_state` 追跡がない** — 毎回全量リフレッシュになる

---

これらを全部直した上で実装を進めます。特に：
- commits は全リポジトリ分を集めてから日別に書く
- `is_private` は `number` (0/1) に変換
- Linear/Withings は実装コードを省略せず書く

    37→async function fetchGitHub<T>(path: string, token: string): Promise<T> {
    38→  const res = await fetch(`https://api.github.com${path}`, {
    39→    headers: {
    40→      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    41→      Accept: "application/vnd.github.v3+json",
    42→      "User-Agent": "ingestion-worker",
    43→    },
    44→  });
    45→  if (!res.ok) {
    46→    throw new Error(`GitHub API error: ${res.status}`);
    47→  }
    48→  return res.json();
    49→}
    50→
    51→async function syncUser(db: D1Database, username: string, token: string): Promise<User> {
    52→  const user = await fetchGitHub<User>(`/users/${username}`, token);
    53→
    54→  await db
    55→    .prepare(
    56→      `INSERT INTO github_users (id, login, name, avatar_url, synced_at)
    57→       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))
    58→       ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
    59→         login = excluded.login,
    60→         name = excluded.name,
    61→         avatar_url = excluded.avatar_url,
    62→         synced_at = excluded.synced_at`
    63→    )
    64→    .bind(user.id, user.login, user.name, user.avatar_url)
    65→    .run();
    66→
    67→  return user;
    68→}
    69→
    70→async function syncRepos(
    71→  db: D1Database,
    72→  username: string,
    73→  userId: number,
    74→  token: string
    75→): Promise<Repo[]> {
    76→  const repos = await fetchGitHub<Repo[]>(
    77→    `/users/${username}/repos?per_page=100&sort=pushed`,
    78→    token
    79→  );
    80→
    81→  for (const repo of repos) {
    82→    await db
    83→      .prepare(
    84→        `INSERT INTO github_repos (id, owner_id, name, full_name, description, language, stars, forks, is_private, default_branch, synced_at)
    85→         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))
    86→         ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
    87→           name = excluded.name,
    88→           full_name = excluded.full_name,
    89→           description = excluded.description,
    90→           language = excluded.language,
    91→           stars = excluded.stars,
    92→           forks = excluded.forks,
    93→           is_private = excluded.is_private,
    94→           default_branch = excluded.default_branch,
    95→           synced_at = excluded.synced_at`
    96→      )
    97→      .bind(
    98→        repo.id,
    99→        userId,
   100→        repo.name,
   101→        repo.full_name,
   102→        repo.description,
   103→        repo.language,
   104→        repo.stargazers_count,
   105→        repo.forks_count,
   106→        repo.private ? 1 : 0,
   107→        repo.default_branch
   108→      )
   109→      .run();
   110→  }
   111→
   112→  return repos;
   113→}
   114→
   115→async function syncCommits(db: D1Database, repo: Repo, token: string): Promise<number> {
   116→  const commits = await fetchGitHub<Commit[]>(
   117→    `/repos/${repo.full_name}/commits?per_page=100`,
   118→    token
   119→  );
   120→
   121→  let synced = 0;
   122→  for (const commit of commits) {
   123→    const message = commit.commit.message.substring(0, 500);
   124→    try {
   125→      await db
   126→        .prepare(
   127→          `INSERT INTO github_commits (sha, repo_id, message, author_name, author_email, author_date, additions, deletions, files_changed, synced_at)
   128→           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, 0, 0, datetime('now'))
   129→           ON CONFLICT(sha) DO NOTHING`
   130→        )
   131→        .bind(
   132→          commit.sha,
   133→          repo.id,
   134→          message,
   135→          commit.commit.author.name,
   136→          commit.commit.author.email,
   137→          commit.commit.author.date
   138→        )
   139→        .run();
   140→      synced++;
   141→    } catch {
   142→      // ignore duplicate
   143→    }
   144→  }
   145→
   146→  return synced;
   147→}
   148→
   149→export async function runSync(env: Env): Promise<SyncResult> {
   150→  const { DB: db, GITHUB_TOKEN: token, GITHUB_USERNAME: username } = env;
   151→
   152→  const user = await syncUser(db, username, token);
   153→  const repos = await syncRepos(db, username, user.id, token);
   154→
   155→  let totalCommits = 0;
   156→  for (const repo of repos.filter((r) => !r.private)) {
   157→    try {
   158→      const count = await syncCommits(db, repo, token);
   159→      totalCommits += count;
   160→    } catch (e) {
   161→      console.error(`Failed to sync commits for ${repo.name}:`, e);
   162→    }
   163→  }
   164→
   165→  return {
   166→    service: "github",
   167→    success: true,
   168→    message: `Synced ${repos.length} repos, ${totalCommits} commits`,
   169→    count: totalCommits,
   170→  };
   171→}
   172→
   173→// Routes
   174→app.post("/sync", async (c) => {
   175→  const result = await runSync(c.env);
   176→  return c.json(result);
   177→});
   178→
   179→app.get("/stats", async (c) => {
   180→  const stats = await c.env.DB.prepare(
   181→    `SELECT
   182→       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM github_repos) as repos,
   183→       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM github_commits) as commits,
   184→       (SELECT MAX(synced_at) FROM github_commits) as last_sync`
   185→  ).first();
   186→  return c.json(stats);
   187→});
   188→
   189→app.get("/daily", async (c) => {
   190→  const results = await c.env.DB.prepare("SELECT * FROM v_daily_commits LIMIT 30").all();
   191→  return c.json(results.results);
   192→});
   193→
   194→app.get("/repos", async (c) => {
   195→  const results = await c.env.DB.prepare("SELECT * FROM v_repo_stats LIMIT 50").all();
   196→  return c.json(results.results);
   197→});
   198→
   199→export default app;

     6→// --- Types ---

    50→
    51→// --- GraphQL Client ---
    52→
    53→async function fetchLinearGraphQL<T>(
    54→  query: string,
    55→  variables: Record<string, unknown>,
    56→  apiKey: string
    57→): Promise<T> {
    58→  const res = await fetch("https://api.linear.app/graphql", {
    59→    method: "POST",
    60→    headers: {
    61→      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    62→      Authorization: apiKey,
    63→    },
    64→    body: JSON.stringify({ query, variables }),
    65→  });
    66→
    67→  if (!res.ok) {
    68→    throw new Error(`Linear API error: ${res.status}`);
    69→  }
    70→
    71→  const json = (await res.json()) as { data?: T; errors?: { message: string }[] };
    72→  if (json.errors?.length) {
    73→    throw new Error(`Linear GraphQL error: ${json.errors[0].message}`);
    74→  }
    75→  return json.data as T;
    76→}
    77→
    78→// --- Pagination Helper ---
    79→
    80→async function fetchAllPages<T>(apiKey: string, query: string, rootField: string): Promise<T[]> {
    81→  const results: T[] = [];
    82→  let after: string | null = null;
    83→
    84→  type Connection = Record<string, { nodes: T[]; pageInfo: PageInfo }>;
    85→  do {
    86→    const data: Connection = await fetchLinearGraphQL<Connection>(
    87→      query,
    88→      { first: 50, after },
    89→      apiKey
    90→    );
    91→    const connection = data[rootField];
    92→    results.push(...connection.nodes);
    93→    after = connection.pageInfo.hasNextPage ? connection.pageInfo.endCursor : null;
    94→  } while (after);
    95→
    96→  return results;
    97→}
    98→
    99→// --- GraphQL Queries ---
   100→
   101→const ISSUES_QUERY = `
   102→  query Issues($first: Int!, $after: String) {
   103→    issues(first: $first, after: $after, orderBy: updatedAt) {
   104→      nodes {
   105→        id identifier title description
   106→        priority estimate
   107→        state { name type }
   108→        labels { nodes { name } }
   109→        project { name }
   110→        cycle { number }
   111→        assignee { name }
   112→        createdAt updatedAt startedAt completedAt canceledAt
   113→        dueDate
   114→      }
   115→      pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }
   116→    }
   117→  }
   118→`;
   119→
   120→const PROJECTS_QUERY = `
   121→  query Projects($first: Int!, $after: String) {
   122→    projects(first: $first, after: $after) {
   123→      nodes {
   124→        id name state progress
   125→        startDate targetDate
   126→        createdAt updatedAt completedAt
   127→      }
   128→      pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }
   129→    }
   130→  }
   131→`;
   132→
   133→const LABELS_QUERY = `
   134→  query Labels {
   135→    issueLabels(first: 250) {

   137→    }
   138→  }
   139→`;

   143→async function syncIssues(db: D1Database, apiKey: string): Promise<number> {

   145→
   146→  const statements = issues.map((issue) => {
   147→    const labelNames = JSON.stringify(issue.labels.nodes.map((l) => l.name));
   148→    return db
   149→      .prepare(
   150→        `INSERT INTO linear_issues (id, identifier, title, description_length, priority, estimate,
   151→           state_name, state_type, label_names, project_name, cycle_number, assignee_name,
   152→           created_at, updated_at, started_at, completed_at, canceled_at, due_date, synced_at)
   153→         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))
   154→         ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
   155→           identifier = excluded.identifier,

   158→           priority = excluded.priority,
   159→           estimate = excluded.estimate,

   162→           label_names = excluded.label_names,
   163→           project_name = excluded.project_name,
   164→           cycle_number = excluded.cycle_number,
   165→           assignee_name = excluded.assignee_name,
   166→           updated_at = excluded.updated_at,
   167→           started_at = excluded.started_at,
   168→           completed_at = excluded.completed_at,
   169→           canceled_at = excluded.canceled_at,
   170→           due_date = excluded.due_date,
   171→           synced_at = excluded.synced_at`
   172→      )
   173→      .bind(
   174→        issue.id,
   175→        issue.identifier,
   176→        issue.title,
   177→        issue.description?.length ?? 0,
   178→        issue.priority,
   179→        issue.estimate,
   180→        issue.state?.name ?? null,

   182→        labelNames,

   189→        issue.completedAt,
   190→        issue.canceledAt,
   191→        issue.dueDate
   192→      );
   193→  });
   194→
   195→  if (statements.length > 0) {

   277→
   278→  await db
   279→    .prepare("UPDATE sync_state SET last_sync_at = datetime('now') WHERE data_source_id = 'linear'")
   280→    .run();
   281→
   282→  return {
   283→    service: "linear",
   284→    success: true,
   285→    message: `Synced ${issueCount} issues, ${projectCount} projects, ${labelCount} labels`,
   286→    count: issueCount,
   287→  };
   288→}
   289→
   290→// --- Routes ---
   291→
   292→app.post("/sync", async (c) => {
   293→  const result = await runSync(c.env);
   294→  return c.json(result);
   295→});
   296→
   297→app.get("/stats", async (c) => {
   298→  const stats = await c.env.DB.prepare(
   299→    `SELECT
   300→       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM linear_issues) as issues,
   301→       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM linear_projects) as projects,
   302→       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM linear_labels) as labels,
   303→       (SELECT MAX(synced_at) FROM linear_issues) as last_sync`
   304→  ).first();
   305→  return c.json(stats);
   306→});
   307→
   308→app.get("/weekly", async (c) => {
   309→  const results = await c.env.DB.prepare("SELECT * FROM v_linear_weekly_completion LIMIT 12").all();
   310→  return c.json(results.results);
   311→});
   312→
   313→app.get("/labels", async (c) => {
   314→  const results = await c.env.DB.prepare("SELECT * FROM v_linear_label_summary LIMIT 50").all();
   315→  return c.json(results.results);
   316→});
   317→
   318→app.get("/projects", async (c) => {
   319→  const results = await c.env.DB.prepare("SELECT * FROM v_linear_project_progress").all();
   320→  return c.json(results.results);
   321→});
   322→
   323→export default app;

    96→async function getValidToken(db: D1Database, env: Env): Promise<string> {
    97→  const row = await db
    98→    .prepare(
    99→      "SELECT access_token, refresh_token, expires_at FROM oauth_tokens WHERE id = 'withings'"
   100→    )
   101→    .first<{ access_token: string; refresh_token: string; expires_at: string }>();
   102→
   103→  if (!row) {
   104→    throw new Error("Withings not authenticated. Visit /withings/auth to connect.");
   105→  }
   106→
   107→  const now = new Date();
   108→  const expiresAt = new Date(row.expires_at);
   109→
   110→  if (now < expiresAt) {
   111→    return row.access_token;
   112→  }
   113→
   114→  // Refresh token (Withings uses action=requesttoken)
   115→  const res = await fetch(WITHINGS_TOKEN_URL, {
   116→    method: "POST",
   117→    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
   118→    body: new URLSearchParams({
   119→      action: "requesttoken",
   120→      grant_type: "refresh_token",
   121→      client_id: env.WITHINGS_CLIENT_ID,
   122→      client_secret: env.WITHINGS_CLIENT_SECRET,
   123→      refresh_token: row.refresh_token,
   124→    }),
   125→  });
   126→
   127→  if (!res.ok) {
   128→    const text = await res.text();
   129→    throw new Error(`Withings token refresh HTTP error: ${res.status} ${text}`);
   130→  }
   131→
   132→  const json: WithingsResponse<WithingsTokenBody> = await res.json();
   133→  if (json.status !== 0) {
   134→    throw new Error(`Withings token refresh failed: status=${json.status} error=${json.error}`);
   135→  }
   136→
   137→  const newExpiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + json.body.expires_in * 1000).toISOString();
   138→
   139→  await db
   140→    .prepare(
   141→      `UPDATE oauth_tokens SET
   142→        access_token = ?, refresh_token = ?, expires_at = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')
   143→       WHERE id = 'withings'`
   144→    )
   145→    .bind(json.body.access_token, json.body.refresh_token, newExpiresAt)
   146→    .run();
   147→
   148→  return json.body.access_token;
   149→}

   155→async function postWithings<T>(
   156→  url: string,
   157→  token: string,
   158→  params: Record<string, string>
   159→): Promise<T> {
   160→  const res = await fetch(url, {
   161→    method: "POST",
   162→    headers: {
   163→      "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
   164→      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
   165→    },
   166→    body: new URLSearchParams(params),
   167→  });
   168→
   169→  if (res.status === 429) {
   170→    throw new Error("Withings API rate limit exceeded");
   171→  }
   172→  if (res.status === 401) {
   173→    throw new Error("Withings API unauthorized - token may be expired");
   174→  }
   175→  if (!res.ok) {
   176→    const body = await res.text();
   177→    const truncated = body.length > 500 ? `${body.slice(0, 500)}...(truncated)` : body;
   178→    throw new Error(`Withings API HTTP error: ${res.status} - ${truncated || "no response body"}`);
   179→  }
   180→
   181→  const json: WithingsResponse<T> = await res.json();
   182→  if (json.status !== 0) {
   183→    throw new Error(`Withings API error: status=${json.status} error=${json.error}`);
   184→  }
   185→
   186→  return json.body;
   187→}

   193→function getDateRange(lastSyncAt: string | null): { startDate: string; endDate: string } {
   194→  const endDate = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
   195→
   196→  if (!lastSyncAt) {
   197→    const start = new Date();
   198→    start.setDate(start.getDate() - 30);
   199→    return { startDate: start.toISOString().split("T")[0], endDate };
   200→  }
   201→
   202→  const start = new Date(lastSyncAt);
   203→  start.setDate(start.getDate() - 1);
   204→  return { startDate: start.toISOString().split("T")[0], endDate };
   205→}
   206→
   207→function toUnix(dateStr: string): number {
   208→  return Math.floor(new Date(dateStr).getTime() / 1000);
   209→}
   210→
   211→/** Convert Withings raw value: actual = value * 10^unit */
   212→function toActualValue(value: number, unit: number): number {
   213→  return value * 10 ** unit;
   214→}

   472→
   473→export async function runSync(
   474→  env: Env,
   475→  overrideStartDate?: string,
   476→  overrideEndDate?: string
   477→): Promise<SyncResult> {
   478→  const db = env.DB;
   479→  const token = await getValidToken(db, env);
   480→
   481→  const syncState = await db
   482→    .prepare("SELECT last_sync_at FROM sync_state WHERE id = 'withings'")
   483→    .first<{ last_sync_at: string | null }>();
   484→
   485→  const lastSyncAt = syncState?.last_sync_at ?? null;
   486→  const { startDate: defaultStart, endDate: defaultEnd } = getDateRange(lastSyncAt);
   487→  const startDate = overrideStartDate ?? defaultStart;
   488→  const endDate = overrideEndDate ?? defaultEnd;
   489→
   490→  const measureCount = await syncMeasures(db, token, startDate, endDate);
   491→  const sleepCount = await syncSleep(db, token, startDate, endDate);
   492→  const activityCount = await syncActivity(db, token, startDate, endDate);
   493→
   494→  if (!overrideStartDate) {
   495→    await db
   496→      .prepare(
   497→        "UPDATE sync_state SET last_sync_at = datetime('now'), updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = 'withings'"
   498→      )
   499→      .run();
   500→  }
   501→
   502→  const total = measureCount + sleepCount + activityCount;
   503→
   504→  return {
   505→    service: "withings",
   506→    success: true,
   507→    message: `Synced ${measureCount} measures, ${sleepCount} sleep, ${activityCount} activity records`,
   508→    count: total,
   509→  };
   510→}

   517→app.get("/auth", async (c) => {
   518→  const state = crypto.randomUUID();
   519→
   520→  const stateExpiry = new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
   521→  await c.env.DB.prepare(
   522→    `INSERT INTO oauth_tokens (id, access_token, refresh_token, expires_at)
   523→     VALUES ('withings_state', ?, '', ?)
   524→     ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET access_token = excluded.access_token, expires_at = excluded.expires_at`
   525→  )
   526→    .bind(state, stateExpiry)
   527→    .run();
   528→
   529→  const params = new URLSearchParams({
   530→    response_type: "code",
   531→    client_id: c.env.WITHINGS_CLIENT_ID,
   532→    redirect_uri: c.env.WITHINGS_REDIRECT_URI,
   533→    scope: "user.info,user.metrics,user.activity",
   534→    state,
   535→  });
   536→  return c.redirect(`${WITHINGS_AUTH_URL}?${params.toString()}`);
   537→});
   538→
   539→// OAuth2 callback
   540→app.get("/callback", async (c) => {
   541→  const code = c.req.query("code");
   542→  const state = c.req.query("state");
   543→  if (!code) {
   544→    return c.json({ error: "Missing authorization code" }, 400);
   545→  }
   546→
   547→  const storedState = await c.env.DB.prepare(
   548→    "SELECT access_token, expires_at FROM oauth_tokens WHERE id = 'withings_state'"
   549→  ).first<{ access_token: string; expires_at: string }>();
   550→
   551→  await c.env.DB.prepare("DELETE FROM oauth_tokens WHERE id = 'withings_state'").run();
   552→
   553→  if (!storedState || storedState.access_token !== state) {
   554→    return c.json({ error: "Invalid state parameter" }, 400);
   555→  }
   556→  if (new Date(storedState.expires_at) < new Date()) {
   557→    return c.json({ error: "State expired, please retry authorization" }, 400);
   558→  }
   559→
   560→  // Withings uses action=requesttoken for token exchange
   561→  const res = await fetch(WITHINGS_TOKEN_URL, {
   562→    method: "POST",
   563→    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
   564→    body: new URLSearchParams({
   565→      action: "requesttoken",
   566→      grant_type: "authorization_code",
   567→      client_id: c.env.WITHINGS_CLIENT_ID,
   568→      client_secret: c.env.WITHINGS_CLIENT_SECRET,
   569→      code,
   570→      redirect_uri: c.env.WITHINGS_REDIRECT_URI,
   571→    }),
   572→  });
   573→
   574→  if (!res.ok) {
   575→    const text = await res.text();
   576→    return c.json({ error: "Token exchange HTTP error", detail: text }, 500);
   577→  }
   578→
   579→  const json: WithingsResponse<WithingsTokenBody> = await res.json();
   580→  if (json.status !== 0) {
   581→    return c.json({ error: "Token exchange failed", status: json.status, detail: json.error }, 500);
   582→  }
   583→
   584→  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + json.body.expires_in * 1000).toISOString();
   585→
   586→  await c.env.DB.prepare(
   587→    `INSERT INTO oauth_tokens (id, access_token, refresh_token, token_type, expires_at, scope, updated_at)
   588→     VALUES ('withings', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))
   589→     ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
   590→       access_token = excluded.access_token,
   591→       refresh_token = excluded.refresh_token,
   592→       token_type = excluded.token_type,
   593→       expires_at = excluded.expires_at,
   594→       scope = excluded.scope,
   595→       updated_at = excluded.updated_at`
   596→  )
   597→    .bind(
   598→      json.body.access_token,
   599→      json.body.refresh_token,
   600→      json.body.token_type,
   601→      expiresAt,
   602→      json.body.scope
   603→    )
   604→    .run();
   605→
   606→  return c.json({ success: true, message: "Withings connected successfully" });
   607→});
   608→
   609→// Manual sync
   610→app.post("/sync", async (c) => {
   611→  try {
   612→    const startDate = c.req.query("start_date");
   613→    const endDate = c.req.query("end_date");
   614→    const result = await runSync(c.env, startDate, endDate);
   615→    return c.json(result);
   616→  } catch (e) {
   617→    const message = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unknown error";
   618→    const status = message.includes("not authenticated") ? 401 : 500;
   619→    return c.json({ service: "withings", success: false, message }, status);
   620→  }
   621→});
   622→
   623→// Stats
   624→app.get("/stats", async (c) => {
   625→  const stats = await c.env.DB.prepare(
   626→    `SELECT
   627→       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM withings_measures) as measure_records,
   628→       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM withings_sleep) as sleep_records,
   629→       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM withings_activity) as activity_records,
   630→       (SELECT last_sync_at FROM sync_state WHERE id = 'withings') as last_sync`
   631→  ).first();
   632→  return c.json(stats);
   633→});
   634→
   635→function parseLimit(raw: string | undefined, defaultVal: number, max = 1000): number {
   636→  const parsed = Number.parseInt(raw ?? String(defaultVal), 10);
   637→  if (Number.isNaN(parsed) || parsed < 1) return defaultVal;
   638→  return Math.min(parsed, max);
   639→}
   640→
   641→// Data endpoints
   642→app.get("/measures", async (c) => {
   643→  const limit = parseLimit(c.req.query("limit"), 30);
   644→  const results = await c.env.DB.prepare(
   645→    "SELECT * FROM withings_measures ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT ?"
   646→  )
   647→    .bind(limit)
   648→    .all();
   649→  return c.json(results.results);
   650→});
   651→
   652→app.get("/sleep", async (c) => {
   653→  const limit = parseLimit(c.req.query("limit"), 30);
   654→  const results = await c.env.DB.prepare("SELECT * FROM withings_sleep ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT ?")
   655→    .bind(limit)
   656→    .all();
   657→  return c.json(results.results);
   658→});
   659→
   660→app.get("/activity", async (c) => {
   661→  const limit = parseLimit(c.req.query("limit"), 30);
   662→  const results = await c.env.DB.prepare(
   663→    "SELECT * FROM withings_activity ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT ?"
   664→  )
   665→    .bind(limit)
   666→    .all();
   667→  return c.json(results.results);
   668→});
   669→
   670→app.get("/daily-summary", async (c) => {
   671→  const limit = parseLimit(c.req.query("limit"), 30);
   672→  const results = await c.env.DB.prepare(
   673→    "SELECT * FROM v_withings_daily_summary ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT ?"
   674→  )
   675→    .bind(limit)
   676→    .all();
   677→  return c.json(results.results);
   678→});
   679→
   680→export default app;

   110→async function getValidToken(db: D1Database, env: Env): Promise<string> {
   111→  const row = await db
   112→    .prepare("SELECT access_token, refresh_token, expires_at FROM oauth_tokens WHERE id = 'oura'")
   113→    .first<{ access_token: string; refresh_token: string; expires_at: string }>();
   114→
   115→  if (!row) {
   116→    throw new Error("Oura not authenticated. Visit /oura/auth to connect.");
   117→  }
   118→
   119→  const now = new Date();
   120→  const expiresAt = new Date(row.expires_at);
   121→
   122→  if (now < expiresAt) {
   123→    return row.access_token;
   124→  }
   125→
   126→  // Refresh token
   127→  const res = await fetch(OURA_TOKEN_URL, {
   128→    method: "POST",
   129→    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
   130→    body: new URLSearchParams({
   131→      grant_type: "refresh_token",
   132→      refresh_token: row.refresh_token,
   133→      client_id: env.OURA_CLIENT_ID,
   134→      client_secret: env.OURA_CLIENT_SECRET,
   135→    }),
   136→  });
   137→
   138→  if (!res.ok) {
   139→    const text = await res.text();
   140→    throw new Error(`Oura token refresh failed: ${res.status} ${text}`);
   141→  }
   142→
   143→  const token=[REDACTED] = await res.json();
   144→  const newExpiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + token.expires_in * 1000).toISOString();
   145→
   146→  await db
   147→    .prepare(
   148→      `UPDATE oauth_tokens SET
   149→        access_token = ?, refresh_token = ?, expires_at = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')
   150→       WHERE id = 'oura'`
   151→    )
   152→    .bind(token.access_token, token.refresh_token, newExpiresAt)
   153→    .run();
   154→
   155→  return token.access_token;
   156→}

   161→
   162→async function fetchOura<T>(
   163→  path: string,
   164→  token: string,
   165→  params?: Record<string, string>
   166→): Promise<OuraResponse<T>> {
   167→  const url = new URL(`${OURA_API_BASE}${path}`);
   168→  if (params) {
   169→    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
   170→      url.searchParams.set(k, v);
   171→    }
   172→  }
   173→
   174→  const res = await fetch(url.toString(), {
   175→    headers: {
   176→      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
   177→      "User-Agent": "ingestion-worker",
   178→    },
   179→  });
   180→
   181→  if (res.status === 429) {
   182→    throw new Error("Oura API rate limit exceeded");
   183→  }
   184→  if (res.status === 401) {
   185→    throw new Error("Oura API unauthorized - token may be expired");
   186→  }
   187→  if (!res.ok) {
   188→    const body = await res.text();
   189→    const truncated = body.length > 500 ? `${body.slice(0, 500)}...(truncated)` : body;
   190→    throw new Error(`Oura API error: ${res.status} - ${truncated || "no response body"}`);
   191→  }
   192→
   193→  return res.json();
   194→}
   195→
   196→async function fetchAllPages<T>(
   197→  path: string,
   198→  token: string,
   199→  params: Record<string, string>
   200→): Promise<T[]> {
   201→  const allData: T[] = [];
   202→  let nextToken: string | undefined;
   203→
   204→  do {
   205→    const reqParams = { ...params };
   206→    if (nextToken) {
   207→      reqParams.next_token = nextToken;
   208→    }
   209→
   210→    const response = await fetchOura<T>(path, token, reqParams);
   211→    allData.push(...response.data);
   212→    nextToken = response.next_token;
   213→  } while (nextToken);
   214→
   215→  return allData;
   216→}

   218→// ============================================
   219→// Chunking & Grouping Utilities
   220→// ============================================
   221→
   222→function splitIntoMonthlyChunks(
   223→  startDate: string,
   224→  endDate: string
   225→): Array<{ start: string; end: string }> {
   226→  const chunks: Array<{ start: string; end: string }> = [];
   227→  let current = new Date(`${startDate}T00:00:00Z`);
   228→  const end = new Date(`${endDate}T00:00:00Z`);
   229→
   230→  while (current <= end) {
   231→    const chunkEnd = new Date(current);
   232→    chunkEnd.setUTCMonth(chunkEnd.getUTCMonth() + 1);
   233→    chunkEnd.setUTCDate(0); // last day of current month
   234→    const effectiveEnd = chunkEnd > end ? end : chunkEnd;
   235→    chunks.push({
   236→      start: current.toISOString().split("T")[0],
   237→      end: effectiveEnd.toISOString().split("T")[0],
   238→    });
   239→    current = new Date(effectiveEnd);
   240→    current.setUTCDate(current.getUTCDate() + 1);
   241→  }
   242→  return chunks;
   243→}
   244→
   245→function groupByDay<T>(items: T[], getDayFn: (item: T) => string): Map<string, T[]> {
   246→  const map = new Map<string, T[]>();
   247→  for (const item of items) {
   248→    const day = getDayFn(item);
   249→    const arr = map.get(day) ?? [];
   250→    arr.push(item);
   251→    map.set(day, arr);
   252→  }
   253→  return map;
   254→}

   430→// ============================================
   431→// Main Sync

   433→
   434→export async function runSync(env: Env): Promise<SyncResult> {
   435→  const db = env.DB;
   436→  const r2 = env.DATA_LAKE;
   437→
   438→  // Initialize parquet-wasm
   439→  initParquetWasm(PARQUET_WASM);
   440→
   441→  // Get valid OAuth token (refreshes if expired)
   442→  let token = await getValidToken(db, env);
   443→
   444→  // Determine date range
   445→  const syncState = await db
   446→    .prepare("SELECT last_sync_at FROM sync_state WHERE id = 'oura'")
   447→    .first<{ last_sync_at: string | null }>();
   448→
   449→  const lastSyncAt = syncState?.last_sync_at ?? null;
   450→  const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
   451→
   452→  let startDate: string;
   453→  if (!lastSyncAt) {
   454→    // First sync: use backfill start date
   455→    startDate = env.OURA_BACKFILL_START_DATE || "2024-01-01";
   456→    console.log(`Oura backfill from ${startDate} to ${today}`);
   457→  } else {
   458→    // Incremental: from last sync - 1 day (overlap for idempotent overwrites)
   459→    const start = new Date(lastSyncAt);
   460→    start.setDate(start.getDate() - 1);
   461→    startDate = start.toISOString().split("T")[0];
   462→  }
   463→
   464→  // Split into monthly chunks
   465→  const chunks = splitIntoMonthlyChunks(startDate, today);
   466→  console.log(`Oura sync: ${chunks.length} monthly chunk(s) from ${startDate} to ${today}`);
   467→
   468→  let totalSleep = 0;
   469→  let totalActivity = 0;
   470→  let totalReadiness = 0;
   471→  let totalHeartRate = 0;
   472→  let lastSuccessfulEnd: string | null = null;
   473→
   474→  for (const chunk of chunks) {
   475→    try {
   476→      // Refresh token if needed before each chunk
   477→      token = await getValidToken(db, env);
   478→
   479→      const sleepCount = await syncDailySleep(r2, token, chunk.start, chunk.end);
   480→      const activityCount = await syncDailyActivity(r2, token, chunk.start, chunk.end);
   481→      const readinessCount = await syncDailyReadiness(r2, token, chunk.start, chunk.end);
   482→
   483→      // Heart rate API has 30-day limit; use inclusive day count
   484→      const chunkDays =
   485→        (new Date(chunk.end).getTime() - new Date(chunk.start).getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24) +
   486→        1;
   487→      const heartRateCount =
   488→        chunkDays > 30 ? 0 : await syncHeartRate(r2, token, chunk.start, chunk.end);
   489→
   490→      totalSleep += sleepCount;
   491→      totalActivity += activityCount;
   492→      totalReadiness += readinessCount;
   493→      totalHeartRate += heartRateCount;
   494→      lastSuccessfulEnd = chunk.end;
   495→
   496→      console.log(
   497→        `Oura chunk ${chunk.start}~${chunk.end}: ${sleepCount} sleep, ${activityCount} activity, ${readinessCount} readiness, ${heartRateCount} HR`
   498→      );
   499→
   500→      // Rate limit: 1s delay between chunks
   501→      if (chunks.indexOf(chunk) < chunks.length - 1) {
   502→        await sleep(1000);
   503→      }
   504→    } catch (e) {
   505→      const message = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unknown error";
   506→      console.error(`Oura chunk ${chunk.start}~${chunk.end} failed: ${message}`);
   507→      if (message.includes("rate limit")) {
   508→        // Skip remaining chunks on rate limit
   509→        break;
   510→      }
   511→      // Other errors: skip this chunk and continue
   512→    }
   513→  }
   514→
   515→  // Only update sync_state if at least one chunk succeeded
   516→  if (lastSuccessfulEnd) {
   517→    await db
   518→      .prepare(
   519→        "UPDATE sync_state SET last_sync_at = ?, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = 'oura'"
   520→      )
   521→      .bind(lastSuccessfulEnd)
   522→      .run();
   523→  }
   524→
   525→  const total = totalSleep + totalActivity + totalReadiness + totalHeartRate;
   526→
   527→  return {
   528→    service: "oura",
   529→    success: true,
   530→    message: `Synced ${totalSleep} sleep, ${totalActivity} activity, ${totalReadiness} readiness, ${totalHeartRate} heart rate records to R2 Parquet`,
   531→    count: total,
   532→  };
   533→}
   534→
   535→// ============================================
   536→// Routes
   537→// ============================================
   538→
   539→// OAuth2 authorization
   540→app.get("/auth", async (c) => {
   541→  const state = crypto.randomUUID();
   542→
   543→  // Persist state for CSRF validation (expires in 10 minutes)
   544→  const stateExpiry = new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
   545→  await c.env.DB.prepare(
   546→    `INSERT INTO oauth_tokens (id, access_token, refresh_token, expires_at)
   547→     VALUES ('oura_state', ?, '', ?)
   548→     ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET access_token = excluded.access_token, expires_at = excluded.expires_at`
   549→  )
   550→    .bind(state, stateExpiry)
   551→    .run();
   552→
   553→  const params = new URLSearchParams({
   554→    response_type: "code",
   555→    client_id: c.env.OURA_CLIENT_ID,
   556→    redirect_uri: c.env.OURA_REDIRECT_URI,
   557→    scope: "daily heartrate",
   558→    state,
   559→  });
   560→  return c.redirect(`${OURA_AUTH_URL}?${params.toString()}`);
   561→});
   562→
   563→// OAuth2 callback
   564→app.get("/callback", async (c) => {
   565→  const code = c.req.query("code");
   566→  const state = c.req.query("state");
   567→  if (!code) {
   568→    return c.json({ error: "Missing authorization code" }, 400);
   569→  }
   570→
   571→  // Validate state for CSRF protection
   572→  const storedState = await c.env.DB.prepare(
   573→    "SELECT access_token, expires_at FROM oauth_tokens WHERE id = 'oura_state'"
   574→  ).first<{ access_token: string; expires_at: string }>();
   575→
   576→  await c.env.DB.prepare("DELETE FROM oauth_tokens WHERE id = 'oura_state'").run();
   577→
   578→  if (!storedState || storedState.access_token !== state) {
   579→    return c.json({ error: "Invalid state parameter" }, 400);
   580→  }
   581→  if (new Date(storedState.expires_at) < new Date()) {
   582→    return c.json({ error: "State expired, please retry authorization" }, 400);
   583→  }
   584→
   585→  const res = await fetch(OURA_TOKEN_URL, {
   586→    method: "POST",
   587→    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
   588→    body: new URLSearchParams({
   589→      grant_type: "authorization_code",
   590→      code,
   591→      client_id: c.env.OURA_CLIENT_ID,
   592→      client_secret: c.env.OURA_CLIENT_SECRET,
   593→      redirect_uri: c.env.OURA_REDIRECT_URI,
   594→    }),
   595→  });
   596→
   597→  if (!res.ok) {
   598→    const text = await res.text();
   599→    return c.json({ error: "Token exchange failed", detail: text }, 500);
   600→  }
   601→
   602→  const token=[REDACTED] = await res.json();
   603→  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + token.expires_in * 1000).toISOString();
   604→
   605→  await c.env.DB.prepare(
   606→    `INSERT INTO oauth_tokens (id, access_token, refresh_token, token_type, expires_at, scope, updated_at)
   607→     VALUES ('oura', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))
   608→     ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
   609→       access_token = excluded.access_token,
   610→       refresh_token = excluded.refresh_token,
   611→       token_type = excluded.token_type,
   612→       expires_at = excluded.expires_at,
   613→       scope = excluded.scope,
   614→       updated_at = excluded.updated_at`
   615→  )
   616→    .bind(token.access_token, token.refresh_token, token.token_type, expiresAt, token.scope ?? null)
   617→    .run();
   618→
   619→  return c.json({ success: true, message: "Oura connected successfully" });
   620→});
   621→
   622→// Manual sync
   623→app.post("/sync", async (c) => {
   624→  try {
   625→    const result = await runSync(c.env);
   626→    return c.json(result);
   627→  } catch (e) {
   628→    const message = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unknown error";
   629→    const status = message.includes("not authenticated") ? 401 : 500;
   630→    return c.json({ service: "oura", success: false, message }, status);
   631→  }
   632→});
   633→
   634→// Stats — list R2 objects count (handles pagination)
   635→app.get("/stats", async (c) => {
   636→  const tables = ["daily_sleep", "daily_activity", "daily_readiness", "heart_rate"];
   637→  const stats: Record<string, number> = {};
   638→
   639→  for (const table of tables) {
   640→    let count = 0;
   641→    let cursor: string | undefined;
   642→    do {
   643→      const list = await c.env.DATA_LAKE.list({ prefix: `oura/${table}/`, cursor });
   644→      count += list.objects.length;
   645→      cursor = list.truncated ? list.cursor : undefined;
   646→    } while (cursor);
   647→    stats[`${table}_files`] = count;
   648→  }
   649→
   650→  const syncState = await c.env.DB.prepare(
   651→    "SELECT last_sync_at FROM sync_state WHERE id = 'oura'"
   652→  ).first<{ last_sync_at: string | null }>();
   653→
   654→  return c.json({ ...stats, last_sync: syncState?.last_sync_at ?? null });
   655→});
   656→
   657→export default app;
   658→

   207→// ============================================
   208→// WASM initialization
   209→// ============================================
   210→
   211→let wasmInitialized = false;
   212→
   213→/**
   214→ * Initialize parquet-wasm synchronously with a pre-loaded WASM module.
   215→ * In Workers: call with the imported .wasm module.
   216→ * In tests: call with the WASM bytes loaded via fs.readFileSync.
   217→ */
   218→export function initParquetWasm(wasmModule: BufferSource | WebAssembly.Module): void {
   219→  if (wasmInitialized) return;
   220→  initSync({ module: wasmModule });
   221→  wasmInitialized = true;
   222→}
   223→
   224→function ensureWasmInit(): void {
   225→  if (!wasmInitialized) {
   226→    throw new Error("parquet-wasm not initialized. Call initParquetWasm() first.");
   227→  }
   228→}
   229→
   230→// ============================================
   231→// Column extraction helpers
   232→// ============================================
   233→
   234→function extractColumn<T, K extends keyof T>(rows: T[], key: K): T[K][] {
   235→  return rows.map((r) => r[key]);
   236→}
   237→
   238→// ============================================
   239→// Encode functions
   240→// ============================================
   241→
   242→function arrowToParquet(columns: Record<string, unknown[]>): Uint8Array {
   243→  const arrowTable = tableFromArrays(columns);
   244→  const ipcBytes = tableToIPC(arrowTable, "stream");
   245→  const wasmTable = WasmTable.fromIPCStream(ipcBytes);
   246→  return writeParquet(wasmTable);
   247→}

> AGENT

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
3つのサービスファイルを並行してリライトします。Oura実装をリファレンスパターンとして:
- **WASM import** → `initParquetWasm(PARQUET_WASM)` で初期化
- **マスターデータ** (users, repos, issues等) → 単一ファイルに全データ上書き
- **時系列データ** (commits, measures等) → `{service}/{table}/{day}.parquet` に日別分割
- D1のデータテーブルへの書き込みは全て削除、メタデータ（`sync_state`, `oauth_tokens`）のみ残す
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

3つのサービスを並行でリライトします。

  "content": "import { Hono } from \"hono\";\n// @ts-expect-error — Wrangler bundles .wasm as WebAssembly.Module\nimport PARQUET_WASM from \"../../node_modules/parquet-wasm/esm/parquet_wasm_bg.wasm\";\nimport type { Env, SyncResult } from \"../types\";\nimport {\n  type GitHubCommitRow,\n  type GitHubRepoRow,\n  type GitHubUserRow,\n  encodeGitHubCommit,\n  encodeGitHubRepo,\n  encodeGitHubUser,\n  initParquetWasm,\n} from \"./parquet\";\n\nconst app = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>();\n\ninterface User {\n  id: number;\n  login: string;\n  name: string | null;\n  avatar_url: string;\n}\n\ninterface Repo {\n  id: number;\n  name: string;\n  full_name: string;\n  description: string | null;\n  language: string | null;\n  stargazers_count: number;\n  forks_count: number;\n  private: boolean;\n  default_branch: string;\n}\n\ninterface Commit {\n  sha: string;\n  commit: {\n    message: string;\n    author: {\n      name: string;\n      email: string;\n      date: string;\n    };\n  };\n}\n\nasync function fetchGitHub<T>(path: string, token: string): Promise<T> {\n  const res = await fetch(`https://api.github.com${path}`, {\n    headers: {\n      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,\n      Accept: \"application/vnd.github.v3+json\",\n      \"User-Agent\": \"ingestion-worker\",\n    },\n  });\n  if (!res.ok) {\n    throw new Error(`GitHub API error: ${res.status}`);\n  }\n  return res.json();\n}\n\nfunction groupByDay(commits: GitHubCommitRow[]): Map<string, GitHubCommitRow[]> {\n  const map = new Map<string, GitHubCommitRow[]>();\n  for (const commit of commits) {\n    const arr = map.get(commit.day) ?? [];\n    arr.push(commit);\n    map.set(commit.day, arr);\n  }\n  return map;\n}\n\nexport async function runSync(env: Env): Promise<SyncResult> {\n  const { GITHUB_TOKEN: token, GITHUB_USERNAME: username, DATA_LAKE: r2 } = env;\n\n  initParquetWasm(PARQUET_WASM);\n  const synced_at = new Date().toISOString();\n\n  // 1. Fetch & write user\n  const user = await fetchGitHub<User>(`/users/${username}`, token);\n  const userRows: GitHubUserRow[] = [\n    {\n      id: user.id,\n      login: user.login,\n      name: user.name,\n      avatar_url: user.avatar_url,\n      synced_at,\n    },\n  ];\n  const userParquet = await encodeGitHubUser(userRows);\n  await r2.put(\"github/users.parquet\", userParquet);\n\n  // 2. Fetch & write repos\n  const repos = await fetchGitHub<Repo[]>(\n    `/users/${username}/repos?per_page=100&sort=pushed`,\n    token\n  );\n  const repoRows: GitHubRepoRow[] = repos.map((repo) => ({\n    id: repo.id,\n    owner_id: user.id,\n    name: repo.name,\n    full_name: repo.full_name,\n    description: repo.description,\n    language: repo.language,\n    stars: repo.stargazers_count,\n    forks: repo.forks_count,\n    is_private: repo.private ? 1 : 0,\n    default_branch: repo.default_branch,\n    synced_at,\n  }));\n  const repoParquet = await encodeGitHubRepo(repoRows);\n  await r2.put(\"github/repos.parquet\", repoParquet);\n\n  // 3. Fetch commits from ALL public repos, then group by day\n  const allCommitRows: GitHubCommitRow[] = [];\n  for (const repo of repos.filter((r) => !r.private)) {\n    try {\n      const commits = await fetchGitHub<Commit[]>(\n        `/repos/${repo.full_name}/commits?per_page=100`,\n        token\n      );\n      for (const commit of commits) {\n        const authorDate = commit.commit.author.date;\n        const day = authorDate.split(\"T\")[0];\n        allCommitRows.push({\n          sha: commit.sha,\n          repo_id: repo.id,\n          repo_full_name: repo.full_name,\n          message: commit.commit.message.substring(0, 500),\n          author_name: commit.commit.author.name,\n          author_email: commit.commit.author.email,\n          author_date: authorDate,\n          day,\n          synced_at,\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.error(`Failed to fetch commits for ${repo.name}:`, e);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Write daily Parquet files (all repos combined per day)\n  const grouped = groupByDay(allCommitRows);\n  for (const [day, rows] of grouped) {\n    const parquet = await encodeGitHubCommit(rows);\n    await r2.put(`github/commits/${day}.parquet`, parquet);\n  }\n\n  return {\n    service: \"github\",\n    success: true,\n    message: `Synced ${repos.length} repos, ${allCommitRows.length} commits to R2 Parquet`,\n    count: allCommitRows.length,\n  };\n}\n\n// Routes\napp.post(\"/sync\", async (c) => {\n  const result = await runSync(c.env);\n  return c.json(result);\n});\n\napp.get(\"/stats\", async (c) => {\n  const r2 = c.env.DATA_LAKE;\n  const prefixes = [\"github/users\", \"github/repos\", \"github/commits/\"];\n  const stats: Record<string, number> = {};\n\n  for (const prefix of prefixes) {\n    let count = 0;\n    let cursor: string | undefined;\n    do {\n      const list = await r2.list({ prefix, cursor });\n      count += list.objects.length;\n      cursor = list.truncated ? list.cursor : undefined;\n    } while (cursor);\n    const key = prefix.endsWith(\"/\") ? prefix.slice(0, -1).split(\"/\").pop()! : prefix.split(\"/\").pop()!;\n    stats[`${key}_files`] = count;\n  }\n\n  return c.json(stats);\n});\n\nexport default app;\n"
}

  "content": "import { Hono } from \"hono\";\n// @ts-expect-error — Wrangler bundles .wasm as WebAssembly.Module\nimport PARQUET_WASM from \"../../node_modules/parquet-wasm/esm/parquet_wasm_bg.wasm\";\nimport type { Env, SyncResult } from \"../types\";\nimport {\n  type LinearIssueRow,\n  type LinearLabelRow,\n  type LinearProjectRow,\n  encodeLinearIssue,\n  encodeLinearLabel,\n  encodeLinearProject,\n  initParquetWasm,\n} from \"./parquet\";\n\nconst app = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>();\n\n// --- Types ---\n\ninterface PageInfo {\n  hasNextPage: boolean;\n  endCursor: string | null;\n}\n\ninterface LinearIssue {\n  id: string;\n  identifier: string;\n  title: string;\n  description: string | null;\n  priority: number;\n  estimate: number | null;\n  state: { name: string; type: string } | null;\n  labels: { nodes: { name: string }[] };\n  project: { name: string } | null;\n  cycle: { number: number } | null;\n  assignee: { name: string } | null;\n  createdAt: string;\n  updatedAt: string;\n  startedAt: string | null;\n  completedAt: string | null;\n  canceledAt: string | null;\n  dueDate: string | null;\n}\n\ninterface LinearProject {\n  id: string;\n  name: string;\n  state: string;\n  progress: number;\n  startDate: string | null;\n  targetDate: string | null;\n  createdAt: string;\n  updatedAt: string;\n  completedAt: string | null;\n}\n\ninterface LinearLabel {\n  id: string;\n  name: string;\n  color: string;\n}\n\n// --- GraphQL Client ---\n\nasync function fetchLinearGraphQL<T>(\n  query: string,\n  variables: Record<string, unknown>,\n  apiKey: string\n): Promise<T> {\n  const res = await fetch(\"https://api.linear.app/graphql\", {\n    method: \"POST\",\n    headers: {\n      \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n      Authorization: apiKey,\n    },\n    body: JSON.stringify({ query, variables }),\n  });\n\n  if (!res.ok) {\n    throw new Error(`Linear API error: ${res.status}`);\n  }\n\n  const json = (await res.json()) as { data?: T; errors?: { message: string }[] };\n  if (json.errors?.length) {\n    throw new Error(`Linear GraphQL error: ${json.errors[0].message}`);\n  }\n  return json.data as T;\n}\n\n// --- Pagination Helper ---\n\nasync function fetchAllPages<T>(apiKey: string, query: string, rootField: string): Promise<T[]> {\n  const results: T[] = [];\n  let after: string | null = null;\n\n  type Connection = Record<string, { nodes: T[]; pageInfo: PageInfo }>;\n  do {\n    const data: Connection = await fetchLinearGraphQL<Connection>(\n      query,\n      { first: 50, after },\n      apiKey\n    );\n    const connection = data[rootField];\n    results.push(...connection.nodes);\n    after = connection.pageInfo.hasNextPage ? connection.pageInfo.endCursor : null;\n  } while (after);\n\n  return results;\n}\n\n// --- GraphQL Queries ---\n\nconst ISSUES_QUERY = `\n  query Issues($first: Int!, $after: String) {\n    issues(first: $first, after: $after, orderBy: updatedAt) {\n      nodes {\n        id identifier title description\n        priority estimate\n        state { name type }\n        labels { nodes { name } }\n        project { name }\n        cycle { number }\n        assignee { name }\n        createdAt updatedAt startedAt completedAt canceledAt\n        dueDate\n      }\n      pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }\n    }\n  }\n`;\n\nconst PROJECTS_QUERY = `\n  query Projects($first: Int!, $after: String) {\n    projects(first: $first, after: $after) {\n      nodes {\n        id name state progress\n        startDate targetDate\n        createdAt updatedAt completedAt\n      }\n      pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }\n    }\n  }\n`;\n\nconst LABELS_QUERY = `\n  query Labels {\n    issueLabels(first: 250) {\n      nodes { id name color }\n    }\n  }\n`;\n\n// --- Main Sync ---\n\nexport async function runSync(env: Env): Promise<SyncResult> {\n  const { LINEAR_API_KEY: apiKey, DATA_LAKE: r2 } = env;\n\n  initParquetWasm(PARQUET_WASM);\n  const synced_at = new Date().toISOString();\n\n  // 1. Fetch & write issues → linear/issues.parquet (snapshot)\n  const issues = await fetchAllPages<LinearIssue>(apiKey, ISSUES_QUERY, \"issues\");\n  const issueRows: LinearIssueRow[] = issues.map((issue) => ({\n    id: issue.id,\n    identifier: issue.identifier,\n    title: issue.title,\n    description_length: issue.description?.length ?? 0,\n    priority: issue.priority,\n    estimate: issue.estimate,\n    state_name: issue.state?.name ?? null,\n    state_type: issue.state?.type ?? null,\n    label_names: JSON.stringify(issue.labels.nodes.map((l) => l.name)),\n    project_name: issue.project?.name ?? null,\n    cycle_number: issue.cycle?.number ?? null,\n    assignee_name: issue.assignee?.name ?? null,\n    created_at: issue.createdAt,\n    updated_at: issue.updatedAt,\n    started_at: issue.startedAt,\n    completed_at: issue.completedAt,\n    canceled_at: issue.canceledAt,\n    due_date: issue.dueDate,\n    synced_at,\n  }));\n  if (issueRows.length > 0) {\n    const parquet = await encodeLinearIssue(issueRows);\n    await r2.put(\"linear/issues.parquet\", parquet);\n  }\n\n  // 2. Fetch & write projects → linear/projects.parquet (snapshot)\n  const projects = await fetchAllPages<LinearProject>(apiKey, PROJECTS_QUERY, \"projects\");\n  const projectRows: LinearProjectRow[] = projects.map((project) => ({\n    id: project.id,\n    name: project.name,\n    state: project.state,\n    progress: project.progress,\n    start_date: project.startDate,\n    target_date: project.targetDate,\n    created_at: project.createdAt,\n    updated_at: project.updatedAt,\n    completed_at: project.completedAt,\n    synced_at,\n  }));\n  if (projectRows.length > 0) {\n    const parquet = await encodeLinearProject(projectRows);\n    await r2.put(\"linear/projects.parquet\", parquet);\n  }\n\n  // 3. Fetch & write labels → linear/labels.parquet (snapshot)\n  const labelsData = await fetchLinearGraphQL<{ issueLabels: { nodes: LinearLabel[] } }>(\n    LABELS_QUERY,\n    {},\n    apiKey\n  );\n  const labels = labelsData.issueLabels.nodes;\n  const labelRows: LinearLabelRow[] = labels.map((label) => ({\n    id: label.id,\n    name: label.name,\n    color: label.color,\n    synced_at,\n  }));\n  if (labelRows.length > 0) {\n    const parquet = await encodeLinearLabel(labelRows);\n    await r2.put(\"linear/labels.parquet\", parquet);\n  }\n\n  // Update sync_state\n  await env.DB.prepare(\n    \"UPDATE sync_state SET last_sync_at = datetime('now') WHERE data_source_id = 'linear'\"\n  ).run();\n\n  return {\n    service: \"linear\",\n    success: true,\n    message: `Synced ${issues.length} issues, ${projects.length} projects, ${labels.length} labels to R2 Parquet`,\n    count: issues.length,\n  };\n}\n\n// --- Routes ---\n\napp.post(\"/sync\", async (c) => {\n  const result = await runSync(c.env);\n  return c.json(result);\n});\n\napp.get(\"/stats\", async (c) => {\n  const r2 = c.env.DATA_LAKE;\n  const files = [\"linear/issues.parquet\", \"linear/projects.parquet\", \"linear/labels.parquet\"];\n  const stats: Record<string, string | null> = {};\n\n  for (const file of files) {\n    const obj = await r2.head(file);\n    const key = file.split(\"/\").pop()!.replace(\".parquet\", \"\");\n    stats[key] = obj ? new Date(obj.uploaded).toISOString() : null;\n  }\n\n  const syncState = await c.env.DB.prepare(\n    \"SELECT last_sync_at FROM sync_state WHERE data_source_id = 'linear'\"\n  ).first<{ last_sync_at: string | null }>();\n\n  return c.json({ ...stats, last_sync: syncState?.last_sync_at ?? null });\n});\n\nexport default app;\n"
}

value: number; unit: number }[];\n}\n\ninterface MeasureBody {\n  updatetime: number;\n  timezone: string;\n  measuregrps: MeasureGroup[];\n  more: number;\n  offset: number;\n}\n\ninterface SleepSeries {\n  startdate: number;\n  enddate: number;\n  date: string;\n  data: Record<string, number | null>;\n}\n\ninterface SleepBody {\n  series: SleepSeries[];\n  more: boolean;\n  offset: number;\n}\n\ninterface ActivityEntry {\n  date: string;\n  steps: number;\n  distance: number;\n  elevation: number;\n  soft: number;\n  moderate: number;\n  intense: number;\n  active: number;\n  calories: number;\n  totalcalories: number;\n  hr_average: number;\n  hr_min: number;\n  hr_max: number;\n}\n\ninterface ActivityBody {\n  activities: ActivityEntry[];\n  more: boolean;\n  offset: number;\n}\n\n// Measure type codes\nconst MEASURE_TYPES: Record<number, string> = {\n  1: \"weight\",\n  5: \"fat_free_mass\",\n  6: \"fat_ratio\",\n  8: \"fat_mass\",\n  11: \"heart_pulse\",\n  76: \"muscle_mass\",\n  77: \"hydration\",\n  88: \"bone_mass\",\n};\n\n// ============================================\n// OAuth2\n// ============================================\n\nasync function getValidToken(db: D1Database, env: Env): Promise<string> {\n  const row = await db\n    .prepare(\n      \"SELECT access_token, refresh_token, expires_at FROM oauth_tokens WHERE id = 'withings'\"\n    )\n    .first<{ access_token: string; Visit /withings/auth to connect.\");\n  }\n\n  const now = new Date();\n  const expiresAt = new Date(row.expires_at);\n\n  if (now < expiresAt) {\n    return row.access_token;\n  }\n\n  // Refresh > AGENT

全テスト通過（18 Workers pool + 23 Parquet encoder = 41テスト）。

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
**各サービスのリライトのポイント:**
- **GitHub**: `syncCommits` で全リポジトリのコミットを `allCommitRows` に集約してから `groupByDay` → 日別ファイル化。これにより、レビューで指摘されたクロスリポジトリ上書き問題を解消
- **Linear**: スナップショットデータなので日別分割なし。`linear/issues.parquet` 等を毎回全上書き
- **Withings**: 各sync関数が全ページネーション結果を集約 → `groupByDay` → 日別ファイル化。`toActualValue(value, unit)` の変換ロジックをそのまま保持
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

次に `index.ts` を確認して、削除した D1 クエリルート (`/github/daily`, `/github/repos`, `/linear/weekly` 等) がメインルーターに影響していないか確認します。

I found relevant search results about the "Code generation from strings disallowed" EvalError in Cloudflare Workers. Here's what the search revealed:

## Key Findings

Using eval or new Function is not allowed in Cloudflare Workers for security reasons. Workers running on Cloudflare's network cannot eval.

The issue appears when libraries attempt to dynamically generate code. For example, AJV v6 uses new Function for dynamic code generation, which is not permitted in edge environments like Cloudflare Workers.

## Common Causes

Several libraries can trigger this error when used with Cloudflare Workers:
- Templating engines like Nunjucks that use eval()
- JSON schema validators (like AJV v6)
- Bundlers using development mode with eval-based source maps
- Other npm packages that rely on dynamic code generation

## Solutions

- Disable devtools in webpack config with `devtool: 'none'` and `mode: 'development'`
- Consider using a validator like @cfworker/json-schema or upgrading to AJV v8 with interpreted mode.
- Use templating engines that don't rely on eval, such as Mustache

Regarding Apache Arrow specifically, while it wasn't directly mentioned in these results, the same restrictions would apply if the library uses dynamic code generation.

Based on the search results, I found relevant information about compatibility issues related to `eval` and `new Function()` in Cloudflare Workers:

## Key Findings

Cloudflare Workers have a restriction that no worker code may use dynamic eval (new Function(code), or eval("code")). This is a fundamental security constraint of the platform.

After upgrading from Wrangler 4.15 to 4.16, Cloudflare Workers fail to deploy or run when dependencies contain eval statements, affecting several popular libraries, including js-sha256@0.9.0, which has more than 1M downloads.

## Current Status

Cloudflare recently enabled the ability to run eval(...) and new Function(...) at the top-level scope in a worker, though it is still forbidden while processing requests but allowed when your worker is starting up.

The search results don't show a specific GitHub issue specifically about Apache Arrow and Cloudflare Workers together, but the general issue is that libraries using `new Function()` or `eval()` for dynamic code generation cannot be used in Cloudflare Workers request handlers, though some limited support exists for top-level evaluation at worker startup time.

export function vectorFromArray(init: any, type?: dtypes.DataType) {
    if (init instanceof Data || init instanceof Vector || init.type instanceof dtypes.DataType || ArrayBuffer.isView(init)) {

    }
    const options: IterableBuilderOptions = { type: type ?? inferType(init), nullValues: [null] };

    if (dtypes.DataType.isDictionary(vector.type)) {
        return vector.memoize();
    }
    return vector;
}

 * @param input Input an object of typed arrays or JavaScript arrays.

export function tableFromArrays<I extends Record<string | number | symbol, TypedArray | BigIntArray | readonly unknown[]>>(input: I): Table<{ [P in keyof I]: ArrayDataType<I[P]> }> {
    type T = { [P in keyof I]: ArrayDataType<I[P]> };
    const vecs = {} as VectorsMap<T>;
    const inputs = Object.entries(input) as [keyof I, I[keyof I]][];
    for (const [key, col] of inputs) {
        vecs[key] = vectorFromArray(col);
    }
    return new Table<T>(vecs);
}

> AGENT

ESM モジュールの export は `configurable: false` なのでオーバーライドできません。テスト環境（Node.js/Vitest）では ESM の freeze を厳密に守りますが、Workers 環境（workerd）では動作が異なる可能性があります。

別のアプローチ: `Builder` クラスのコンストラクタで `_isValid` が設定される前にプロトタイプにデフォルトを仕込むか、もしくは直接ビルドされた `.mjs` ファイルをパッチするか。

最も確実な方法: **`tableFromArrays` を使わず、TypedArray → `makeVector` → `Table` のパスで Builder を完全に回避する**方法です。

> DEVELOPER

Typescript から脱却するのは？RustやPythonやGoで書くのがいいと思う

> AGENT

いい着眼点です。現状の問題を整理すると:

**根本原因:** `apache-arrow` JS が `new Function()` を使う → Workers で動かない

選択肢を整理します:

| アプローチ | 工数 | メリット | デメリット |
|-----------|------|---------|-----------|
| **A: apache-arrow JS を回避** | 小 | 既存コードほぼそのまま | ハック的 |
| **B: Rust WASM で JSON→Parquet** | 中 | Workers最適、`parquet-wasm` と同じ技術 | Rust ビルド環境が必要 |
| **C: Python で外部サービス化** | 大 | pyarrow は成熟、型安全 | Workers外にサービス追加 |
| **D: Go WASM** | 大 | Go経験あり（Pulumi） | WASM サイズ大、Workers制限 |

**現実的にはA or B**だと思います:

- **A**: `parquet-wasm` の WASM 側 API だけで Parquet を書く（apache-arrow JS を完全に除去）。`parquet-wasm` 自体は Rust→WASM なので `new Function()` 問題がない。Arrow IPC の構築を JS でやるのをやめて、WASM に JSON を直接渡す方法があるかを調査する方向

- **B**: 小さな Rust crate を作り、`JSON → Arrow → Parquet` 変換を全て Rust/WASM 内で完結させる。`parquet-wasm` は内部で `arrow-rs` + `parquet-rs` を使っているので、同じクレートで自前 WASM を作る

どの方向で進めますか？

# Languages

Workers is a polyglot platform, and provides first-class support for the following programming languages:

* [ JavaScript ](/workers/languages/javascript/)
* [ TypeScript ](/workers/languages/typescript/)
* [ Python Workers ](/workers/languages/python/)
* [ Rust ](/workers/languages/rust/)

Workers also supports [WebAssembly](/workers/runtime-apis/webassembly/) (abbreviated as "Wasm") — a binary format that many languages can be compiled to. This allows you to write Workers using programming language beyond the languages listed above, including C, C++, Kotlin, Go and more.

# WebAssembly (Wasm)

[WebAssembly ↗](https://webassembly.org/) (abbreviated Wasm) allows you to compile languages like [Rust](/workers/languages/rust/), Go, or C to a binary format that can run in a wide variety of environments, including [web browsers ↗](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/WebAssembly#browser%5Fcompatibility), Cloudflare Workers, and other WebAssembly runtimes.


You can use WebAssembly to:

* Execute code written in a language other than JavaScript, via `WebAssembly.instantiate()`.  
Note  
`WebAssembly.instantiate()` only supports pre-compiled modules as documented in the [web-standards documentation](/workers/runtime-apis/web-standards/#javascript-standards).
* Write an entire Cloudflare Worker in Rust, using bindings that make Workers' JavaScript APIs available directly from your Rust code.

Most programming languages can be compiled to Wasm, although support varies across languages and compilers. Guides are available for the following languages:

* [ Wasm in JavaScript ](/workers/runtime-apis/webassembly/javascript/)

## Supported proposals

WebAssembly is a rapidly evolving set of standards, with [many proposed APIs ↗](https://webassembly.org/roadmap/) which are in various stages of development. In general, Workers supports the same set of features that are available in Google Chrome.

### SIMD

SIMD is supported on Workers. For more information on using SIMD in WebAssembly, refer to [Fast, parallel applications with WebAssembly SIMD ↗](https://v8.dev/features/simd).

### Threading

Threading is not possible in Workers. Each Worker runs in a single thread, and the [Web Worker ↗](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web%5FWorkers%5FAPI) API is not supported.

## Binary size

Compiling to WebAssembly often requires including additional runtime dependencies. As a result, Workers that use WebAssembly are typically larger than an equivalent Worker written in JavaScript. The larger your Worker is, the longer it may take your Worker to start. Refer to [Worker startup time ↗](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/#worker-startup-time) for more information. We recommend using tools like [wasm-opt ↗](https://github.com/brson/wasm-opt-rs) to optimize the size of your Wasm binary.

## WebAssembly System Interface (WASI)

The [WebAssembly System Interface ↗](https://wasi.dev/) (abbreviated WASI) is a modular system interface for

Copy page

# Rust

Cloudflare Workers provides support for Rust via the [workers-rs crate ↗](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-rs), which makes [Runtime APIs](/workers/runtime-apis) and [bindings](/workers/runtime-apis/bindings/) to developer platform products, such as [Workers KV](/kv/concepts/how-kv-works/), [R2](/r2/), and [Queues](/queues/), available directly from your Rust code.

By following this guide, you will learn how to build a Worker entirely in the Rust programming language.

## Prerequisites

Before starting this guide, make sure you have:

* A recent version of [Rust ↗](https://rustup.rs/)
* [npm ↗](https://docs.npmjs.com/getting-started)
* The Rust `wasm32-unknown-unknown` toolchain:

Terminal window

```

rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown


```

* And `cargo-generate` sub-command by running:

Terminal window

```

cargo install cargo-generate


```

## 1\. Create a new project with Wrangler

Open a terminal window, and run the following command to generate a Worker project template in Rust:

Terminal window

```

cargo generate cloudflare/workers-rs


```

Your project will be created in a new directory that you named, in which you will find the following files and folders:

* `Cargo.toml` \- The standard project configuration file for Rust's [Cargo ↗](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/) package manager. The template pre-populates some best-practice settings for building for Wasm on Workers.
* `wrangler.toml` \- Wrangler configuration, pre-populated with a custom build command to invoke `worker-build` (Refer to [Wrangler Bundling](/w
* [Secret ↗](https://docs.rs/worker/latest/worker/struct.Secret.html) \- Secret value configured in Cloudflare dashboard or using `wrangler secret put`.
* [Var ↗](https://docs.rs/worker/latest/worker/type.Var.html) \- Environment variable defined in `wrangler.toml`.
* [KvStore ↗](https://docs.rs/worker/latest/worker/kv/struct.KvStore.html) \- Workers [KV](/kv/api/) namespace binding.
* [ObjectNamespace ↗](https://docs.rs/worker/latest/worker/durable/struct.ObjectNamespace.html) \- [Durable Object](/durable-objects/) binding.

### Fetchers no longer have get/put/delete helper methods

| **Default as of**   | 2024-03-26                     |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| **Flag to enable**  | fetcher\_no\_get\_put\_delete  |
| **Flag to disable** | fetcher\_has\_get\_put\_delete |

[Durable Object](/durable-objects/) stubs and [Service Bindings](/workers/runtime-apis/bindings/service-bindings/) both implement a `fetch()` method which behaves similarly to the global `fetch()` method, but requests are instead sent to the destination represented by the object, rather than being routed based on the URL.

Historically, API objects that had such a `fetch()` method also had methods `get()`, `put()`, and `delete()`. These methods were thin wrappers around `fetch()` which would perform the corresponding HTTP method and automatically handle writing/reading the request/response bodies as needed.

These methods were a very early idea from many years ago, but were never actually documented, and therefore rarely (if ever) used. Enabling the `fetcher_no_get_put_delete`, or setting a compatibility date on or after `2024-03-26` disables these methods for your Worker.

This change paves a future path for you to be able to define your own custom methods using these names. Without this change, you would be unable to define your own `get`, `put`, and `delete` methods, since they would conflict with these built-in helper methods.

### Queues send messages in `JSON` format

| **Default as of**   | 2024-03-18                 |
| ------------------- | -------------------------- |
| **Flag to enable**  | queues\_json\_messages     |
| **Flag to disable** | no\_queues\_json\_messages |

With the `queues_json_messages` flag set, Queue bindings will serialize values passed to `send()` or `sendBatch()` into JSON format by default (when no specific `contentType` is provided).
