# Rust

Cloudflare Workers provides support for Rust via the [workers-rs crate ↗](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-rs), which makes [Runtime APIs](/workers/runtime-apis) and [bindings](/workers/runtime-apis/bindings/) to developer platform products, such as [Workers KV](/kv/concepts/how-kv-works/), [R2](/r2/), and [Queues](/queues/), available directly from your Rust code.

By following this guide, you will learn how to build a Worker entirely in the Rust programming language.

## Prerequisites

Before starting this guide, make sure you have:

* A recent version of [Rust ↗](https://rustup.rs/)
* [npm ↗](https://docs.npmjs.com/getting-started)
* The Rust `wasm32-unknown-unknown` toolchain:

Terminal window

```

rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown


```

* And `cargo-generate` sub-command by running:

Terminal window

```

cargo install cargo-generate


```

## 1\. Create a new project with Wrangler

Open a terminal window, and run the following command to generate a Worker project template in Rust:

Terminal window

```

cargo generate cloudflare/workers-rs


```

Your project will be created in a new directory that you named, in which you will find the following files and folders:

* `Cargo.toml` \- The standard project configuration file for Rust's [Cargo ↗](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/) package manager. The template pre-populates some best-practice settings for building for Wasm on Workers.
* `wrangler.toml` \- Wrangler configuration, pre-populated with a custom build command to invoke `worker-build` (Refer to [Wrangler Bundling](/w

npx wrangler deploy


```

Preview your Worker at `<YOUR_WORKER>.<YOUR_SUBDOMAIN>.workers.dev`.

Note

When pushing to your `*.workers.dev` subdomain for the first time, you may see [523 errors](/support/troubleshooting/http-status-codes/cloudflare-5xx-errors/error-523/) while DNS is propagating. These errors should resolve themselves after a minute or so.

After completing these steps, you will have a basic Rust-based Worker deployed. From here, you can add crate dependencies and write code in Rust to implement your Worker application. If you would like to know more about the inner workings of how Rust compiled to Wasm is supported by Workers, the next section outlines the libraries and tools involved.

## How this deployment works

Wasm Workers are invoked from a JavaScript entrypoint script which is created automatically for you when using `workers-rs`.


Workers.
* `wrangler.toml` \- Wrangler configuration, pre-populated with a custom build command to invoke `worker-build` (Refer to [Wrangler Bundling](/workers/languages/rust/#bundling-worker-build)).
* `src` \- Rust source directory, pre-populated with Hello World Worker.

## 2\. Develop locally

After you have created your first Worker, run the [wrangler dev](/workers/wrangler/commands/#dev) command to start a local server for developing your Worker. This will allow you to test your Worker in development.

Terminal window

```

npx wrangler dev


```

If you have not used Wrangler before, it will try to open your web browser to login with your Cloudflare account.

Note

If you have issues with this step or you do not have access to a browser interface, refer to the [wrangler login](/workers/wrangler/commands/#login) documentation for more information.

Go to [http://localhost:8787 ↗](http://localhost:8787) to review your Worker running. Any changes you make to your code will trigger a rebuild, and reloading the page will show you the up-to-date output of your Worker.

## 3\. Write your Worker code

With your new project generated, write your Worker code. Find the entrypoint to your Worker in `src/lib.rs`:

```

use worker::*;


#[event(fetch)]

async fn main(req: Request, env: Env, ctx: Context) -> Result<Response> {

    Response::ok("Hello, World!")

}


```

Provides access to [waitUntil](/workers/runtime-apis/context/#waituntil) (deferred asynchronous tasks) and [passThroughOnException](/workers/runtime-apis/context/#passthroughonexception) (fail open) functionality.

#### [Response ↗](https://docs.rs/worker/latest/worker/struct.Response.html)

The `fetch` handler expects a [Response ↗](https://docs.rs/worker/latest/worker/struct.Response.html) return type, which includes support for streaming responses to the client asynchronously. This is also the return type of any subrequests made from your Worker. There are methods for accessing status code and headers, as well as streaming the body asynchronously or deserializing from JSON using [Serde ↗](https://serde.rs/).

#### `Router`

Implements convenient [routing API ↗](https://docs.rs/worker/latest/worker/struct.Router.html) to serve multiple paths from one Worker. Refer to the [Router example in the worker-rs GitHub repository ↗](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-rs#or-use-the-router).

## 4\. Deploy your Worker project

With your project configured, you can now deploy your Worker, to a `*.workers.dev` subdomain, or a [Custom Domain](/workers/configuration/routing/custom-domains/), if you have one configured. If you have not configured any subdomain or domain, Wrangler will prompt you during the deployment process to set one up.

Terminal window

```

# Python Workers

Cloudflare Workers provides a first-class Python experience, including support for:

* Easy to install and fast-booting [Packages](/workers/languages/python/packages), including [FastAPI ↗](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/), [Langchain ↗](https://pypi.org/project/langchain/), [httpx ↗](https://www.python-httpx.org/), [Pydantic ↗](https://docs.pydantic.dev/latest/) and more.
* A robust [foreign function interface (FFI)](/workers/languages/python/ffi) that lets you use JavaScript objects and functions directly from Python — including all [Runtime APIs](/workers/runtime-apis/)
* An ecosystem of services on the Workers Platform accessible via [bindings](/workers/runtime-apis/bindings/), including:  
   * State storage and databases like [KV](/kv), [D1](/d1), [Durable Objects](/durable-objects/)  
   * Access to [Environment Variables](/workers/configuration/environment-variables/), [Secrets](/workers/configuration/secrets/), and other Workers using [Service Bindings](/workers/runtime-apis/bindings/service-bindings/)  
   * AI capabilities with [Workers AI](/workers-ai/), [Vectorize](/vectorize)  
   * File storage with [R2](/r2)  
   * [Durable Workflows](/workflows/), [Queues](/queues/), and [ more](/workers/runtime-apis/bindings/)

## Introduction

A Python Worker can be as simple as four lines of code:

Python

```

from workers import WorkerEntrypoint, Response


class Default(WorkerEntrypoint):

    async def fetch(self, request):

        return Response("Hello World!")


```

</text>
</result>
<result>
<url>https://developers.cloudflare.com/https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/examples/query-d1-from-python-workers/</url>
<title></title>
<text>

from workers import Response, WorkerEntrypoint


class Default(WorkerEntrypoint):

    async def fetch(self, request):

        # Do anything else you'd like on request here!


        try:

            # Query D1 - we'll list all tables in our database in this example

            results = await self.env.DB.prepare("PRAGMA table_list").run()

            # Return a JSON response

            return Response.json(results)

        except Exception as e:

            return Response.json({"error": "Database query failed"}, status=500)


```

The value of `binding` in your Wrangler file exactly must match the name of the variable in your Python code. This example refers to the database via a `DB` binding, and query this binding via `await env.DB.prepare(...)`.

You can then deploy your Python Worker directly:

Terminal window

```

npx wrangler deploy


```

# Query D1 from Python Workers

**Last reviewed:**  almost 2 years ago 

Learn how to query D1 from a Python Worker

The Cloudflare Workers platform supports [multiple languages](/workers/languages/), including TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust and Python. This guide shows you how to query a D1 database from [Python](/workers/languages/python/) and deploy your application globally.

Note

Support for Python in Cloudflare Workers is in beta. Review the [documentation on Python support](/workers/languages/python/) to understand how Python works within the Workers platform.

## Prerequisites

Before getting started, you should:

1. Review the [D1 tutorial](/d1/get-started/) for TypeScript and JavaScript to learn how to **create a D1 database and configure a Workers project**.
2. Refer to the [Python language guide](/workers/languages/python/) to understand how Python support works on the Workers platform.
3. Have basic familiarity with the Python language.

If you are new to Cloudflare Workers, refer to the [Get started guide](/workers/get-started/guide/) first before continuing with this example.

## Query from Python

This example assumes you have an existing D1 database. To allow your Python Worker to query your database, you first need to create a [binding](/workers/runtime-apis/bindings/) between your Worker and your D1 database and define this in your [Wrangler configuration file](/workers/wrangler/configuration/).

# Workers Bindings

## Workers

[Workers](/workers/) provides a serverless execution environment that allows you to create new applications or augment existing ones.

To use Workers AI with Workers, you must create a Workers AI [binding](/workers/runtime-apis/bindings/). Bindings allow your Workers to interact with resources, like Workers AI, on the Cloudflare Developer Platform. You create bindings on the Cloudflare dashboard or by updating your [Wrangler file](/workers/wrangler/configuration/).

To bind Workers AI to your Worker, add the following to the end of your Wrangler file:

> AGENT

おっしゃる通りでした。Workers は多言語サポートが充実しています:

| 言語 | サポート | R2/D1バインディング | Parquetライブラリ |
|------|---------|-------------------|-----------------|
| **Rust** | ファーストクラス (`workers-rs` crate) | `Bucket`, `D1Database` 直接利用可 | `arrow-rs` + `parquet-rs` (ネイティブ、WASM制限なし) |
| **Python** | ファーストクラス (beta) | FFI経由で R2/D1 利用可 | `pyarrow` / `fastparquet` |
| **Go** | WASM経由 | 自前バインディング必要 | `parquet-go` |

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- **Rust Worker が最適解**。`parquet-rs` は `parquet-wasm` の内部で使われているのと同じクレートで、Workers ネイティブ実行なので `new Function()` 問題は存在しない
- **Python Worker** も有力。`pyarrow` が使えればワンライナーで Parquet 書ける。ただし beta
- 現在の TS 実装の問題は「JS の apache-arrow が Workers の sandbox 制限に引っかかる」という**言語側のエコシステム問題**
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

**推奨: Rust Worker に切り替え**

理由:
1. `parquet-rs` + `arrow-rs` が Workers でネイティブ動作（WASM制限・`eval` 制限なし）
2. `workers-rs` crate で R2 バインディングが直接使える（`env.bucket("DATA_LAKE").put(...)`)
3. このプロジェクトは既に Go (Pulumi) を使っているので、非 JS 言語の導入は自然
4. TypeScript の Hono ルーティング部分はそのまま残し、Parquet 変換部分だけ Rust Worker に分離する「Service Binding」パターンも可能

どう進めますか？

- **A**: Parquet 変換だけ Rust Worker に分離（Service Binding で TS Worker から呼ぶ）
- **B**: ingestion Worker 全体を Rust で書き直す
- **C**: Python Worker で試す（beta だが `pyarrow` の手軽さ）

> DEVELOPER

A

   210→// ============================================
   211→// WASM initialization
   212→// ============================================
   213→
   214→let wasmInitialized = false;
   215→
   216→/**
   217→ * Initialize parquet-wasm synchronously with a pre-loaded WASM module.
   218→ * In Workers: call with the imported .wasm module.
   219→ * In tests: call with the WASM bytes loaded via fs.readFileSync.
   220→ */
   221→export function initParquetWasm(wasmModule: BufferSource | WebAssembly.Module): void {
   222→  if (wasmInitialized) return;
   223→  initSync({ module: wasmModule });
   224→  wasmInitialized = true;
   225→}
   226→
   227→function ensureWasmInit(): void {
   228→  if (!wasmInitialized) {
   229→    throw new Error("parquet-wasm not initialized. Call initParquetWasm() first.");
   230→  }
   231→}
   232→
   233→// ============================================
   234→// Column extraction helpers
   235→// ============================================
   236→
   237→function extractColumn<T, K extends keyof T>(rows: T[], key: K): T[K][] {
   238→  return rows.map((r) => r[key]);
   239→}
   240→
   241→// ============================================
   242→// Encode functions
   243→// ============================================
   244→
   245→function arrowToParquet(columns: Record<string, unknown[]>): Uint8Array {
   246→  const arrowTable = tableFromArrays(columns);
   247→  const ipcBytes = tableToIPC(arrowTable, "stream");
   248→  const wasmTable = WasmTable.fromIPCStream(ipcBytes);
   249→  return writeParquet(wasmTable);
   250→}

   253→  ensureWasmInit();
   254→  return arrowToParquet({
   255→    day: extractColumn(rows, "day"),
   256→    score: extractColumn(rows, "score"),
   257→    deep_sleep: extractColumn(rows, "deep_sleep"),
   258→    efficiency: extractColumn(rows, "efficiency"),

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
**Service Binding パターン**: 現在の各サービスは `PARQUET_WASM` モジュールをインポートして `initParquetWasm()` で初期化後、各 `encode*()` 関数を呼んでいます。新しいアーキテクチャでは、これらの encode 関数が内部的に Rust Worker へ HTTP POST するだけになるので、WASM インポートも初期化も不要になります。各サービスは `encode*()` のシグネチャを変えずに使い続けられます（ただし `env.PARQUET_ENCODER` を渡す必要あり）。
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
**シグネチャ変更のポイント**: 全 `encode*()` 関数に第1引数 `encoder: Fetcher` を追加しました。`Fetcher` は Cloudflare Workers の Service Binding 型で、`fetch()` を呼ぶと同一 Cloudflare アカウント内の別 Worker にリクエストを送れます。URL のホスト名部分は無視されるため `https://parquet-encoder/encode` のような任意の URL が使えます。
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

    79→  const user = await fetchGitHub<User>(`/users/${username}`, token);
    80→  const userRows: GitHubUserRow[] = [
    81→    {
    82→      id: user.id,
    83→      login: user.login,
    84→      name: user.name,
    85→      avatar_url: user.avatar_url,
    86→      synced_at,
    87→    },
    88→  ];
    89→  const userParquet = await encodeGitHubUser(userRows);
    90→  await r2.put("github/users.parquet", userParquet);
    91→
    92→  // 2. Fetch & write repos
    93→  const repos = await fetchGitHub<Repo[]>(
    94→    `/users/${username}/repos?per_page=100&sort=pushed`,
    95→    token
    96→  );
    97→  const repoRows: GitHubRepoRow[] = repos.map((repo) => ({
    98→    id: repo.id,
    99→    owner_id: user.id,
   100→    name: repo.name,
   101→    full_name: repo.full_name,
   102→    description: repo.description,
   103→    language: repo.language,
   104→    stars: repo.stargazers_count,
   105→    forks: repo.forks_count,
   106→    is_private: repo.private ? 1 : 0,
   107→    default_branch: repo.default_branch,
   108→    synced_at,
   109→  }));
   110→  const repoParquet = await encodeGitHubRepo(repoRows);
   111→  await r2.put("github/repos.parquet", repoParquet);
   112→
   113→  // 3. Fetch commits from ALL public repos, then group by day
   114→  const allCommitRows: GitHubCommitRow[] = [];
   115→  for (const repo of repos.filter((r) => !r.private)) {
   116→    try {
   117→      const commits = await fetchGitHub<Commit[]>(
   118→        `/repos/${repo.full_name}/commits?per_page=100`,
   119→        token
   120→      );
   121→      for (const commit of commits) {
   122→        const authorDate = commit.commit.author.date;
   123→        const day = authorDate.split("T")[0];
   124→        allCommitRows.push({
   125→          sha: commit.sha,
   126→          repo_id: repo.id,
   127→          repo_full_name: repo.full_name,
   128→          message: commit.commit.message.substring(0, 500),
   129→          author_name: commit.commit.author.name,
   130→          author_email: commit.commit.author.email,
   131→          author_date: authorDate,
   132→          day,
   133→          synced_at,
   134→        });
   135→      }
   136→    } catch (e) {
   137→      console.error(`Failed to fetch commits for ${repo.name}:`, e);
   138→    }
   139→  }
   140→
   141→  // Write daily Parquet files (all repos combined per day)
   142→  const grouped = groupByDay(allCommitRows);
   143→  for (const [day, rows] of grouped) {
   144→    const parquet = await encodeGitHubCommit(rows);
   145→    await r2.put(`github/commits/${day}.parquet`, parquet);
   146→  }
   147→
   148→  return {
   149→    service: "github",
   150→    success: true,
   151→    message: `Synced ${repos.length} repos, ${allCommitRows.length} commits to R2 Parquet`,
   152→    count: allCommitRows.length,
   153→  };
   154→}
   155→
   156→// Routes
   157→app.post("/sync", async (c) => {
   158→  const result = await runSync(c.env);
   159→  return c.json(result);
   160→});
   161→
   162→app.get("/stats", async (c) => {
   163→  const r2 = c.env.DATA_LAKE;
   164→  const counts: Record<string, number> = { users: 0, repos: 0, commits: 0 };
   165→
   166→  for (const [name, prefix] of Object.entries({
   167→    users: "github/users",
   168→    repos: "github/repos",
   169→    commits: "github/commits/",
   170→  })) {
   171→    let cursor: string | undefined;
   172→    do {
   173→      const list = await r2.list({ prefix, cursor });
   174→      counts[name] += list.objects.length;
   175→      cursor = list.truncated ? list.cursor : undefined;
   176→    } while (cursor);
   177→  }
   178→
   179→  const stats = {
   180→    users_files: counts.users,
   181→    repos_files: counts.repos,
   182→    commits_files: counts.commits,
   183→  };
   184→
   185→  return c.json(stats);
   186→});
   187→
   188→export default app;
   189→

     1→import { Hono } from "hono";
     2→// @ts-expect-error — Wrangler bundles .wasm as WebAssembly.Module
     3→import PARQUET_WASM from "../../node_modules/parquet-wasm/esm/parquet_wasm_bg.wasm";
     4→import type { Env, SyncResult } from "../types";
     5→import {
     6→  encodeLinearIssue,
     7→  encodeLinearLabel,
     8→  encodeLinearProject,
     9→  initParquetWasm,
    10→  type LinearIssueRow,
    11→  type LinearLabelRow,
    12→  type LinearProjectRow,
    13→} from "./parquet";
    14→
    15→const app = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>();
    16→
    17→// --- Types ---
    18→
    19→interface PageInfo {
    20→  hasNextPage: boolean;
    21→  endCursor: string | null;
    22→}
    23→
    24→interface LinearIssue {
    25→  id: string;
    26→  identifier: string;
    27→  title: string;
    28→  description: string | null;
    29→  priority: number;
    30→  estimate: number | null;
    31→  state: { name: string; type: string } | null;
    32→  labels: { nodes: { name: string }[] };
    33→  project: { name: string } | null;
    34→  cycle: { number: number } | null;
    35→  assignee: { name: string } | null;
    36→  createdAt: string;
    37→  updatedAt: string;
    38→  startedAt: string | null;
    39→  completedAt: string | null;
    40→  canceledAt: string | null;
    41→  dueDate: string | null;
    42→}
    43→
    44→interface LinearProject {
    45→  id: string;
    46→  name: string;
    47→  state: string;
    48→  progress: number;
    49→  startDate: string | null;
    50→  targetDate: string | null;
    51→  createdAt: string;
    52→  updatedAt: string;
    53→  completedAt: string | null;
    54→}
    55→
    56→interface LinearLabel {
    57→  id: string;
    58→  name: string;
    59→  color: string;
    60→}
    61→
    62→// --- GraphQL Client ---
    63→
    64→async function fetchLinearGraphQL<T>(
    65→  query: string,
    66→  variables: Record<string, unknown>,
    67→  apiKey: string
    68→): Promise<T> {
    69→  const res = await fetch("https://api.linear.app/graphql", {
    70→    method: "POST",
    71→    headers: {
    72→      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    73→      Authorization: apiKey,
    74→    },
    75→    body: JSON.stringify({ query, variables }),
    76→  });
    77→
    78→  if (!res.ok) {
    79→    throw new Error(`Linear API error: ${res.status}`);
    80→  }
    81→
    82→  const json = (await res.json()) as { data?: T; errors?: { message: string }[] };
    83→  if (json.errors?.length) {
    84→    throw new Error(`Linear GraphQL error: ${json.errors[0].message}`);
    85→  }
    86→  return json.data as T;
    87→}
    88→
    89→// --- Pagination Helper ---
    90→
    91→async function fetchAllPages<T>(apiKey: string, query: string, rootField: string): Promise<T[]> {
    92→  const results: T[] = [];
    93→  let after: string | null = null;
    94→
    95→  type Connection = Record<string, { nodes: T[]; pageInfo: PageInfo }>;
    96→  do {
    97→    const data: Connection = await fetchLinearGraphQL<Connection>(
    98→      query,
    99→      { first: 50, after },
   100→      apiKey
   101→    );
   102→    const connection = data[rootField];
   103→    results.push(...connection.nodes);
   104→    after = connection.pageInfo.hasNextPage ? connection.pageInfo.endCursor : null;
   105→  } while (after);
   106→
   107→  return results;
   108→}
   109→
   110→// --- GraphQL Queries ---
   111→
   112→const ISSUES_QUERY = `
   113→  query Issues($first: Int!, $after: String) {
   114→    issues(first: $first, after: $after, orderBy: updatedAt) {
   115→      nodes {
   116→        id identifier title description
   117→        priority estimate
   118→        state { name type }
   119→        labels { nodes { name } }
   120→        project { name }
   121→        cycle { number }
   122→        assignee { name }
   123→        createdAt updatedAt startedAt completedAt canceledAt
   124→        dueDate
   125→      }
   126→      pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }
   127→    }
   128→  }
   129→`;
   130→
   131→const PROJECTS_QUERY = `
   132→  query Projects($first: Int!, $after: String) {
   133→    projects(first: $first, after: $after) {
   134→      nodes {
   135→        id name state progress
   136→        startDate targetDate
   137→        createdAt updatedAt completedAt
   138→      }
   139→      pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }
   140→    }
   141→  }
   142→`;
   143→
   144→const LABELS_QUERY = `
   145→  query Labels {
   146→    issueLabels(first: 250) {
   147→      nodes { id name color }
   148→    }
   149→  }
   150→`;
   151→
   152→// --- Main Sync ---
   153→
   154→export async function runSync(env: Env): Promise<SyncResult> {
   155→  const { LINEAR_API_KEY: apiKey, DATA_LAKE: r2 } = env;
   156→
   157→  initParquetWasm(PARQUET_WASM);
   158→  const synced_at = new Date().toISOString();
   159→
   160→  // 1. Fetch & write issues → linear/issues.parquet (snapshot)
   161→  const issues = await fetchAllPages<LinearIssue>(apiKey, ISSUES_QUERY, "issues");
   162→  const issueRows: LinearIssueRow[] = issues.map((issue) => ({
   163→    id: issue.id,
   164→    identifier: issue.identifier,
   165→    title: issue.title,
   166→    description_length: issue.description?.length ?? 0,
   167→    priority: issue.priority,
   168→    estimate: issue.estimate,
   169→    state_name: issue.state?.name ?? null,
   170→    state_type: issue.state?.type ?? null,
   171→    label_names: JSON.stringify(issue.labels.nodes.map((l) => l.name)),
   172→    project_name: issue.project?.name ?? null,
   173→    cycle_number: issue.cycle?.number ?? null,
   174→    assignee_name: issue.assignee?.name ?? null,
   175→    created_at: issue.createdAt,
   176→    updated_at: issue.updatedAt,
   177→    started_at: issue.startedAt,
   178→    completed_at: issue.completedAt,
   179→    canceled_at: issue.canceledAt,
   180→    due_date: issue.dueDate,
   181→    synced_at,
   182→  }));
   183→  if (issueRows.length > 0) {
   184→    const parquet = await encodeLinearIssue(issueRows);
   185→    await r2.put("linear/issues.parquet", parquet);
   186→  }
   187→
   188→  // 2. Fetch & write projects → linear/projects.parquet (snapshot)
   189→  const projects = await fetchAllPages<LinearProject>(apiKey, PROJECTS_QUERY, "projects");
   190→  const projectRows: LinearProjectRow[] = projects.map((project) => ({
   191→    id: project.id,
   192→    name: project.name,
   193→    state: project.state,
   194→    progress: project.progress,
   195→    start_date: project.startDate,
   196→    target_date: project.targetDate,
   197→    created_at: project.createdAt,
   198→    updated_at: project.updatedAt,
   199→    completed_at: project.completedAt,
   200→    synced_at,
   201→  }));
   202→  if (projectRows.length > 0) {
   203→    const parquet = await encodeLinearProject(projectRows);
   204→    await r2.put("linear/projects.parquet", parquet);
   205→  }
   206→
   207→  // 3. Fetch & write labels → linear/labels.parquet (snapshot)
   208→  const labelsData = await fetchLinearGraphQL<{ issueLabels: { nodes: LinearLabel[] } }>(
   209→    LABELS_QUERY,
   210→    {},
   211→    apiKey
   212→  );
   213→  const labels = labelsData.issueLabels.nodes;
   214→  const labelRows: LinearLabelRow[] = labels.map((label) => ({
   215→    id: label.id,
   216→    name: label.name,
   217→    color: label.color,
   218→    synced_at,
   219→  }));
   220→  if (labelRows.length > 0) {
   221→    const parquet = await encodeLinearLabel(labelRows);
   222→    await r2.put("linear/labels.parquet", parquet);
   223→  }
   224→
   225→  // Update sync_state
   226→  await env.DB.prepare(
   227→    "UPDATE sync_state SET last_sync_at = datetime('now') WHERE data_source_id = 'linear'"
   228→  ).run();
   229→
   230→  return {
   231→    service: "linear",
   232→    success: true,
   233→    message: `Synced ${issues.length} issues, ${projects.length} projects, ${labels.length} labels to R2 Parquet`,
   234→    count: issues.length,
   235→  };
   236→}
   237→
   238→// --- Routes ---
   239→
   240→app.post("/sync", async (c) => {
   241→  const result = await runSync(c.env);
   242→  return c.json(result);
   243→});
   244→
   245→app.get("/stats", async (c) => {
   246→  const r2 = c.env.DATA_LAKE;
   247→  const files = ["linear/issues.parquet", "linear/projects.parquet", "linear/labels.parquet"];
   248→  const stats: Record<string, string | null> = {};
   249→
   250→  for (const file of files) {
   251→    const obj = await r2.head(file);
   252→    const key = file.split("/").pop()?.replace(".parquet", "") ?? file;
   253→    stats[key] = obj ? new Date(obj.uploaded).toISOString() : null;
   254→  }
   255→
   256→  const syncState = await c.env.DB.prepare(
   257→    "SELECT last_sync_at FROM sync_state WHERE data_source_id = 'linear'"
   258→  ).first<{ last_sync_at: string | null }>();
   259→
   260→  return c.json({ ...stats, last_sync: syncState?.last_sync_at ?? null });
   261→});
   262→
   263→export default app;
   264→

   103→// ============================================
   104→// OAuth2

   106→
   107→async function getValidToken(db: D1Database, env: Env): Promise<string> {
   108→  const row = await db
   109→    .prepare(
   110→      "SELECT access_token, refresh_token, expires_at FROM oauth_tokens WHERE id = 'withings'"
   111→    )
   112→    .first<{ access_token: string; refresh_token: string; expires_at: string }>();
   113→
   114→  if (!row) {
   115→    throw new Error("Withings not authenticated. Visit /withings/auth to connect.");
   116→  }
   117→
   118→  const now = new Date();
   119→  const expiresAt = new Date(row.expires_at);
   120→
   121→  if (now < expiresAt) {
   122→    return row.access_token;
   123→  }
   124→
   125→  // Refresh token (Withings uses action=requesttoken)
   126→  const res = await fetch(WITHINGS_TOKEN_URL, {
   127→    method: "POST",
   128→    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
   129→    body: new URLSearchParams({
   130→      action: "requesttoken",
   131→      grant_type: "refresh_token",
   132→      client_id: env.WITHINGS_CLIENT_ID,
   133→      client_secret: env.WITHINGS_CLIENT_SECRET,
   134→      refresh_token: row.refresh_token,
   135→    }),
   136→  });
   137→
   138→  if (!res.ok) {
   139→    const text = await res.text();
   140→    throw new Error(`Withings token refresh HTTP error: ${res.status} ${text}`);
   141→  }
   142→
   143→  const json: WithingsResponse<WithingsTokenBody> = await res.json();
   144→  if (json.status !== 0) {
   145→    throw new Error(`Withings token refresh failed: status=${json.status} error=${json.error}`);
   146→  }
   147→
   148→  const newExpiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + json.body.expires_in * 1000).toISOString();
   149→
   150→  await db
   151→    .prepare(
   152→      `UPDATE oauth_tokens SET
   153→        access_token = ?, refresh_token = ?, expires_at = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')
   154→       WHERE id = 'withings'`
   155→    )
   156→    .bind(json.body.access_token, json.body.refresh_token, newExpiresAt)
   157→    .run();
   158→
   159→  return json.body.access_token;
   160→}

   162→// ============================================
   163→// API Client
   164→// ============================================
   165→
   166→async function postWithings<T>(
   167→  url: string,
   168→  token: string,
   169→  params: Record<string, string>
   170→): Promise<T> {
   171→  const res = await fetch(url, {
   172→    method: "POST",
   173→    headers: {
   174→      "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
   175→      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
   176→    },
   177→    body: new URLSearchParams(params),
   178→  });
   179→
   180→  if (res.status === 429) {
   181→    throw new Error("Withings API rate limit exceeded");
   182→  }
   183→  if (res.status === 401) {
   184→    throw new Error("Withings API unauthorized - token may be expired");
   185→  }
   186→  if (!res.ok) {
   187→    const body = await res.text();
   188→    const truncated = body.length > 500 ? `${body.slice(0, 500)}...(truncated)` : body;
   189→    throw new Error(`Withings API HTTP error: ${res.status} - ${truncated || "no response body"}`);
   190→  }
   191→
   192→  const json: WithingsResponse<T> = await res.json();
   193→  if (json.status !== 0) {
   194→    throw new Error(`Withings API error: status=${json.status} error=${json.error}`);
   195→  }
   196→
   197→  return json.body;
   198→}

   200→// ============================================
   201→// Helpers
   202→// ============================================
   203→
   204→function getDateRange(lastSyncAt: string | null): { startDate: string; endDate: string } {
   205→  const endDate = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
   206→
   207→  if (!lastSyncAt) {
   208→    const start = new Date();
   209→    start.setDate(start.getDate() - 30);
   210→    return { startDate: start.toISOString().split("T")[0], endDate };
   211→  }
   212→
   213→  const start = new Date(lastSyncAt);
   214→  start.setDate(start.getDate() - 1);
   215→  return { startDate: start.toISOString().split("T")[0], endDate };
   216→}
   217→
   218→function toUnix(dateStr: string): number {
   219→  return Math.floor(new Date(dateStr).getTime() / 1000);
   220→}
   221→
   222→/** Convert Withings raw value: actual = value * 10^unit */
   223→function toActualValue(value: number, unit: number): number {
   224→  return value * 10 ** unit;
   225→}
   226→
   227→function groupByDay<T>(items: T[], getDayFn: (item: T) => string): Map<string, T[]> {
   228→  const map = new Map<string, T[]>();
   229→  for (const item of items) {
   230→    const day = getDayFn(item);
   231→    const arr = map.get(day) ?? [];
   232→    arr.push(item);
   233→    map.set(day, arr);
   234→  }
   235→  return map;
   236→}

   262→  "steps",

   264→  "elevation",
   265→  "soft",
   266→  "moderate",

   268→  "active",

   276→async function syncMeasures(
   277→  r2: R2Bucket,
   278→  token: string,
   279→  startDate: string,
   280→  endDate: string,
   281→  synced_at: string
   282→): Promise<number> {
   283→  let offset = 0;
   284→  const allRows: WithingsMeasureRow[] = [];
   285→
   286→  while (true) {
   287→    const body = await postWithings<MeasureBody>(WITHINGS_MEASURE_URL, token, {
   288→      action: "getmeas",
   289→      category: "1",
   290→      startdate: String(toUnix(startDate)),
   291→      enddate: String(toUnix(endDate) + 86400),
   292→      offset: String(offset),
   293→    });
   294→
   295→    for (const grp of body.measuregrps) {
   296→      const values: Record<string, number | null> = {};
   297→      for (const m of grp.measures) {
   298→        const field = MEASURE_TYPES[m.type];
   299→        if (field) {
   300→          values[field] = toActualValue(m.value, m.unit);
   301→        }
   302→      }
   303→
   304→      const date = new Date(grp.date * 1000).toISOString().split("T")[0];
   305→
   306→      allRows.push({
   307→        grpid: grp.grpid,
   308→        date,
   309→        timestamp: grp.date,
   310→        weight: values.weight ?? null,
   311→        fat_ratio: values.fat_ratio ?? null,
   312→        fat_mass: values.fat_mass ?? null,
   313→        fat_free_mass: values.fat_free_mass ?? null,
   314→        muscle_mass: values.muscle_mass ?? null,
   315→        bone_mass: values.bone_mass ?? null,
   316→        hydration: values.hydration ?? null,
   317→        heart_pulse: values.heart_pulse ?? null,
   318→        synced_at,
   319→      });
   320→    }
   321→
   322→    if (!body.more) break;
   323→    offset = body.offset;
   324→  }
   325→
   326→  // Group by day and write daily Parquet files
   327→  const grouped = groupByDay(allRows, (r) => r.date);
   328→  for (const [day, rows] of grouped) {
   329→    const parquet = await encodeWithingsMeasure(rows);
   330→    await r2.put(`withings/measures/${day}.parquet`, parquet);
   331→  }
   332→
   333→  return allRows.length;
   334→}

   445→
   446→// ============================================
   447→// Main Sync
   448→// ============================================
   449→
   450→export async function runSync(
   451→  env: Env,
   452→  overrideStartDate?: string,
   453→  overrideEndDate?: string
   454→): Promise<SyncResult> {
   455→  const db = env.DB;
   456→  const r2 = env.DATA_LAKE;
   457→
   458→  initParquetWasm(PARQUET_WASM);
   459→  const token = await getValidToken(db, env);
   460→  const synced_at = new Date().toISOString();
   461→
   462→  const syncState = await db
   463→    .prepare("SELECT last_sync_at FROM sync_state WHERE id = 'withings'")
   464→    .first<{ last_sync_at: string | null }>();
   465→
   466→  const lastSyncAt = syncState?.last_sync_at ?? null;
   467→  const { startDate: defaultStart, endDate: defaultEnd } = getDateRange(lastSyncAt);
   468→  const startDate = overrideStartDate ?? defaultStart;
   469→  const endDate = overrideEndDate ?? defaultEnd;
   470→
   471→  const measureCount = await syncMeasures(r2, token, startDate, endDate, synced_at);
   472→  const sleepCount = await syncSleep(r2, token, startDate, endDate, synced_at);
   473→  const activityCount = await syncActivity(r2, token, startDate, endDate, synced_at);
   474→
   475→  if (!overrideStartDate) {
   476→    await db
   477→      .prepare(
   478→        "UPDATE sync_state SET last_sync_at = datetime('now'), updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = 'withings'"
   479→      )
   480→      .run();
   481→  }
   482→
   483→  const total = measureCount + sleepCount + activityCount;
   484→
   485→  return {
   486→    service: "withings",
   487→    success: true,
   488→    message: `Synced ${measureCount} measures, ${sleepCount} sleep, ${activityCount} activity records to R2 Parquet`,
   489→    count: total,
   490→  };
   491→}

   493→// ============================================
   494→// Routes
   495→// ============================================
   496→
   497→// OAuth2 authorization
   498→app.get("/auth", async (c) => {
   499→  const state = crypto.randomUUID();
   500→
   501→  const stateExpiry = new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
   502→  await c.env.DB.prepare(
   503→    `INSERT INTO oauth_tokens (id, access_token, refresh_token, expires_at)
   504→     VALUES ('withings_state', ?, '', ?)
   505→     ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET access_token = excluded.access_token, expires_at = excluded.expires_at`
   506→  )
   507→    .bind(state, stateExpiry)
   508→    .run();
   509→
   510→  const params = new URLSearchParams({
   511→    response_type: "code",
   512→    client_id: c.env.WITHINGS_CLIENT_ID,
   513→    redirect_uri: c.env.WITHINGS_REDIRECT_URI,
   514→    scope: "user.info,user.metrics,user.activity",
   515→    state,
   516→  });
   517→  return c.redirect(`${WITHINGS_AUTH_URL}?${params.toString()}`);
   518→});
   519→
   520→// OAuth2 callback
   521→app.get("/callback", async (c) => {
   522→  const code = c.req.query("code");
   523→  const state = c.req.query("state");
   524→  if (!code) {
   525→    return c.json({ error: "Missing authorization code" }, 400);
   526→  }
   527→
   528→  const storedState = await c.env.DB.prepare(
   529→    "SELECT access_token, expires_at FROM oauth_tokens WHERE id = 'withings_state'"
   530→  ).first<{ access_token: string; expires_at: string }>();
   531→
   532→  await c.env.DB.prepare("DELETE FROM oauth_tokens WHERE id = 'withings_state'").run();
   533→
   534→  if (!storedState || storedState.access_token !== state) {
   535→    return c.json({ error: "Invalid state parameter" }, 400);
   536→  }
   537→  if (new Date(storedState.expires_at) < new Date()) {
   538→    return c.json({ error: "State expired, please retry authorization" }, 400);
   539→  }
   540→
   541→  // Withings uses action=requesttoken for token exchange
   542→  const res = await fetch(WITHINGS_TOKEN_URL, {
   543→    method: "POST",
   544→    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
   545→    body: new URLSearchParams({
   546→      action: "requesttoken",
   547→      grant_type: "authorization_code",
   548→      client_id: c.env.WITHINGS_CLIENT_ID,
   549→      client_secret: c.env.WITHINGS_CLIENT_SECRET,
   550→      code,
   551→      redirect_uri: c.env.WITHINGS_REDIRECT_URI,
   552→    }),
   553→  });
   554→
   555→  if (!res.ok) {
   556→    const text = await res.text();
   557→    return c.json({ error: "Token exchange HTTP error", detail: text }, 500);
   558→  }
   559→
   560→  const json: WithingsResponse<WithingsTokenBody> = await res.json();
   561→  if (json.status !== 0) {
   562→    return c.json({ error: "Token exchange failed", status: json.status, detail: json.error }, 500);
   563→  }
   564→
   565→  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + json.body.expires_in * 1000).toISOString();
   566→
   567→  await c.env.DB.prepare(
   568→    `INSERT INTO oauth_tokens (id, access_token, refresh_token, token_type, expires_at, scope, updated_at)
   569→     VALUES ('withings', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))
   570→     ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
   571→       access_token = excluded.access_token,
   572→       refresh_token = excluded.refresh_token,
   573→       token_type = excluded.token_type,
   574→       expires_at = excluded.expires_at,
   575→       scope = excluded.scope,
   576→       updated_at = excluded.updated_at`
   577→  )
   578→    .bind(
   579→      json.body.access_token,
   580→      json.body.refresh_token,
   581→      json.body.token_type,
   582→      expiresAt,
   583→      json.body.scope
   584→    )
   585→    .run();
   586→
   587→  return c.json({ success: true, message: "Withings connected successfully" });
   588→});
   589→
   590→// Manual sync
   591→app.post("/sync", async (c) => {
   592→  try {
   593→    const startDate = c.req.query("start_date");
   594→    const endDate = c.req.query("end_date");
   595→    const result = await runSync(c.env, startDate, endDate);
   596→    return c.json(result);
   597→  } catch (e) {
   598→    const message = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unknown error";
   599→    const status = message.includes("not authenticated") ? 401 : 500;
   600→    return c.json({ service: "withings", success: false, message }, status);
   601→  }
   602→});
   603→
   604→// Stats — list R2 objects
   605→app.get("/stats", async (c) => {
   606→  const r2 = c.env.DATA_LAKE;
   607→  const tables = ["measures", "sleep", "activity"];
   608→  const stats: Record<string, number> = {};
   609→
   610→  for (const table of tables) {
   611→    let count = 0;
   612→    let cursor: string | undefined;
   613→    do {
   614→      const list = await r2.list({ prefix: `withings/${table}/`, cursor });
   615→      count += list.objects.length;
   616→      cursor = list.truncated ? list.cursor : undefined;
   617→    } while (cursor);
   618→    stats[`${table}_files`] = count;
   619→  }
   620→
   621→  const syncState = await c.env.DB.prepare(
   622→    "SELECT last_sync_at FROM sync_state WHERE id = 'withings'"
   623→  ).first<{ last_sync_at: string | null }>();
   624→
   625→  return c.json({ ...stats, last_sync: syncState?.last_sync_at ?? null });
   626→});
   627→
   628→export default app;
   629→
```

   399→  endDate: string
   400→): Promise<number> {
   401→  // Heart rate API uses datetime params and has a 30-day limit
   402→  const data = await fetchAllPages<OuraHeartRate>("/v2/usercollection/heartrate", token, {
   403→    start_datetime: `${startDate}T00:00:00+00:00`,
   404→    end_datetime: `${endDate}T23:59:59+00:00`,
   405→  });
   406→
   407→  if (data.length === 0) return 0;
   408→
   409→  const synced_at = new Date().toISOString();
   410→  const grouped = groupByDay(data, (item) => item.timestamp.split("T")[0]);
   411→
   412→  for (const [day, items] of grouped) {
   413→    const rows: HeartRateRow[] = items.map((item) => ({
   414→      bpm: item.bpm,
   415→      source: item.source,
   416→      timestamp: item.timestamp,
   417→      day,
   418→      synced_at,
   419→    }));
   420→    const parquet = await encodeHeartRate(rows);
   421→    await writeParquetToR2(r2, "heart_rate", day, parquet);
   422→  }
   423→
   424→  return data.length;
   425→}
   426→
   427→// ============================================
   428→// Main Sync
   429→// ============================================
   430→
   431→export async function runSync(env: Env): Promise<SyncResult> {
   432→  const db = env.DB;
   433→  const r2 = env.DATA_LAKE;
   434→  const encoder = env.PARQUET_ENCODER;
   435→
   436→  // Get valid OAuth token (refreshes if expired)
   437→  let token = await getValidToken(db, env);
```

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
**テスト戦略の転換**: 以前の parquet テストは Node.js 環境で WASM を直接ロードして Parquet バイト列を生成していました。新アーキテクチャでは encode 関数が Rust Worker への HTTP 呼び出しになるため、Node.js 単体テストでは Service Binding をモック（`fetch` を返す fake Fetcher）する必要があります。テストの目的は「正しいスキーマ名と行データで Rust Worker を呼んでいるか」の検証に変わります。
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

parquet テストを Service Binding のモックに書き換えます。

> AGENT

**全34テスト合格** (Workers pool 17 + Parquet unit 17)。

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
**アーキテクチャ変更のまとめ**: 今回の変更で、Parquet エンコードのデータフローが大きく変わりました:

- **Before**: TS Worker → apache-arrow JS → parquet-wasm (WASM) → Parquet bytes → R2  
  問題: `new Function()` が Workers sandbox で禁止されていた

- **After**: TS Worker → HTTP POST (Service Binding) → Rust Worker (arrow-rs + parquet-rs) → Parquet bytes → TS Worker → R2  
  利点: Rust は Workers でネイティブ実行、JS ランタイムの制約を完全に回避

Service Binding は同一 Cloudflare アカウント内の Worker 間通信で、ネットワークを経由せず内部パス（最大数十マイクロ秒のレイテンシ）で処理されます。
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

> AGENT

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
**zstd の wasm32 非互換**: `zstd` feature は C ライブラリ (`zstd-sys`) に依存しており、`clang` が `wasm32-unknown-unknown` ターゲットをサポートしていないためコンパイル失敗します。一方 `snap` (Snappy圧縮) は純粋な Rust 実装なので wasm32 で動作します。Parquet ファイルのデフォルト圧縮としては Snappy で十分です。
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

`zstd` feature を削除します。

> TOOL

  "file_path": "/Users/ta93abe/Developer/github.com/ta93abe/data-engineering-with-cloudflare/parquet-encoder/Cargo.toml",
  "old_string": "parquet = { version = \"55\", default-features = false, features = [\"arrow\", \"snap\", \"zstd\"] }",
  "new_string": "parquet = { version = \"55\", default-features = false, features = [\"arrow\", \"snap\"] }"
}

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
**WASM バイナリサイズ**: 1.8MB は arrow-rs + parquet-rs を含むとしては非常にコンパクトです。`opt-level = "s"` (サイズ最適化) と `lto = true` (Link-Time Optimization) の効果です。Cloudflare Workers の圧縮後 WASM サイズ上限は有料プランで 10MB なので余裕があります。

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
Rust Worker のビルドは `worker-build --release` が `cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release` を実行し、WASM バイナリを生成します。`cloudflare/wrangler-action` は `wrangler deploy` を実行するだけですが、`wrangler.jsonc` の `build.command` に `worker-build` が指定されているため、デプロイ前に自動でビルドが走ります。ただし、Rust ツールチェインの事前インストールが必要です。
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- **`Swatinem/rust-cache`**: `target/` ディレクトリのキャッシュにより、arrow-rs/parquet-rs のビルド時間を大幅に短縮します（初回5-10分→キャッシュヒット時1-2分程度）
- **`wrangler.jsonc` の `build.command`**: `wrangler deploy` が自動的に `cargo install worker-build && worker-build --release` を実行するため、ワークフロー側で明示的にビルドコマンドを書く必要がありません
- **paths フィルタ**: `parquet-encoder/**` の変更があった場合のみデプロイが走るので、他のWorkerの変更では不要なビルドが発生しません
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

ワークフローを作成しました。ポイント:

- **トリガー**: `main` ブランチへの push で `parquet-encoder/` 配下に変更がある場合 + 手動実行(`workflow_dispatch`)
- **Rust ツールチェイン**: `dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable` で `wasm32-unknown-unknown` ターゲットをインストール
- **キャッシュ**: `Swatinem/rust-cache` で依存クレートのビルドキャッシュ（初回以降のビルド高速化）
- **デプロイ**: 既存ワークフローと同じ `cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3` + 同じ secrets を使用

管理画面でWorkersとGitレポジトリを紐づけてもできる？

> AGENT

はい、できます。ingestion Worker と同じ方法ですね。

Cloudflare Dashboard の **Workers > Settings > Builds** から GitHub リポジトリを紐づけると、main への push で自動デプロイされます。

**Rust Worker でも動く理由:**
- Cloudflare のビルド環境には Rust ツールチェインがプリインストールされている
- `wrangler.jsonc` の `build.command` に `cargo install worker-build && worker-build --release` が定義済みなので、ビルドコマンドの追加設定は不要

**設定手順:**
1. Cloudflare Dashboard → Workers & Pages → `parquet-encoder`
2. Settings → Builds → Connect to Git
3. GitHub リポジトリ `ta93abe/data-engineering-with-cloudflare` を選択
4. Root directory: `parquet-encoder`
5. Production branch: `main`

**GitHub Actions と比較:**

| | Dashboard連携 | GitHub Actions |
|---|---|---|
| セットアップ | GUI数クリック | YAMLファイル作成 |
| ビルドログ | Cloudflare Dashboard | GitHub Actions タブ |
| Rust キャッシュ | Cloudflare管理 | `rust-cache` で制御可能 |
| 柔軟性 | 低い | 高い（テスト追加等） |
| 管理の一元化 | ingestionと同じ方式 | CI/CDはGitHub側に集約 |

ingestion Worker が既に Dashboard 連携で動いているなら、同じ方式で揃えるのがシンプルです。その場合、先ほど作成した `.github/workflows/deploy-parquet-encoder.yml` は不要になるので削除します。

Cloudflare Dashboard での設定手順はこちらです:

1. **Cloudflare Dashboard** にログイン
2. **Workers & Pages** → `parquet-encoder` を選択
3. **Settings** タブ → **Build** セクション
4. **Connect to Git** をクリック
5. GitHub アカウントを連携し、リポジトリ `ta93abe/data-engineering-with-cloudflare` を選択
6. 以下を設定:
   - **Production branch**: `main`
   - **Root directory (advanced)**: `parquet-encoder`
   - **Build command**: 空欄でOK（`wrangler.jsonc` の `build.command` が使われる）
7. **Save and Deploy**

もし Dashboard の画面で迷っているところがあれば、その画面のスクリーンショットを共有してください。

> DEVELOPER

非本番時のビルドは？

> AGENT

Cloudflare の Git 連携では、Production と Preview の2つのビルド設定があります。

**Production**: `main` ブランチへの push でデプロイ
**Preview**: PR作成/更新時にプレビューURLを発行

設定画面で以下を指定:

| 設定項目 | Production | Preview |
|---------|-----------|---------|
| Branch | `main` | All non-production branches（またはPR時のみ） |
| Root directory | `parquet-encoder` | `parquet-encoder` |
| Build command | 空欄（wrangler.jsonc準拠） | 同上 |

Preview ビルドが有効だと、PR を出すたびに Rust のフルビルド（初回5-10分）が走ります。

**選択肢:**
1. **Preview 有効**: PR ごとにプレビューURLが発行される。Service Binding のテストは直接できないが、`/health` や `/schemas` で動作確認可能
2. **Preview 無効**: main マージ時のみビルド。PR での確認は不要と割り切る

## Summary
- apache-arrow JS uses `new Function()` which is forbidden in Cloudflare Workers sandbox (EvalError)
- Added a **Rust Worker** (`parquet-encoder/`) using arrow-rs + parquet-rs that handles JSON→Parquet encoding
- Ingestion Worker calls it via **Service Binding** (`PARQUET_ENCODER: Fetcher`)
- Removed `apache-arrow` and `parquet-wasm` npm dependencies entirely

### Architecture
```
ingestion (TS/Hono) --Service Binding--> parquet-encoder (Rust/arrow-rs)
     |                                        |
     |  POST /encode {schema, rows}           |
     |  <-- Parquet bytes (application/octet-stream)
     v
   R2 (data-lake)
```

### parquet-encoder Worker
- `POST /encode` — accepts `{schema: string, rows: [...]}`, returns Parquet bytes
- `GET /health` — health check
- `GET /schemas` — lists all 13 supported schemas
- Deployed at `https://parquet-encoder.ta93abe.workers.dev`
- WASM size: 1.8 MB (gzip: 532 KB), startup: 1ms

### Changes
- **New**: `parquet-encoder/` — Rust Worker with arrow v58, parquet v58, worker v0.7
- **Rewritten**: `ingestion/src/services/parquet.ts` — Service Binding calls instead of apache-arrow
- **Updated**: All 4 service files (oura, github, linear, withings) to pass `encoder` arg
- **Updated**: `types.ts` — added `PARQUET_ENCODER: Fetcher` to `Env`
- **Updated**: `wrangler.jsonc` — added Service Binding, removed `nodejs_compat`
- **Updated**: Tests — mock Fetcher for parquet tests, mock Worker for integration tests
- **Removed**: `apache-arrow`, `parquet-wasm` npm dependencies

## Test plan
- [x] 17 parquet unit tests pass (mock Fetcher)
- [x] 17 Workers pool integration tests pass (mock parquet-encoder Worker)
- [x] `parquet-encoder` deployed and verified (`/health`, `/schemas`, `POST /encode`)
- [ ] `ingestion` deploy after merge (auto-deploy via Cloudflare GitHub integration)
- [ ] Manual sync test (`POST /github/sync`, etc.) after ingestion deploy

## Was this helpful?

# Workers integration

[Cloudflare Secrets Store](/secrets-store/) is a secure, centralized location in which account-level secrets are stored and managed. The secrets are securely encrypted and stored across all Cloudflare data centers.


Note

You may also add account secrets directly from the Workers settings on the dashboard. You can skip to [step 2](#via-dashboard) to do that.

* [ Wrangler ](#tab-panel-3553)
* [ Dashboard ](#tab-panel-3554)
* [ API ](#tab-panel-3555)

Use the [Wrangler command](/workers/wrangler/commands/#secrets-store-secret) `secrets-store secret create`.

To use the following example, replace the store ID and secret name by your actual data. You can find and copy the store ID from the [Secrets Store tab ↗](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/secrets-store/) on the dashboard or use `wrangler secrets-store store list`.

Note that a secret name cannot contain spaces.

Terminal window

```

npx wrangler secrets-store secret create <STORE_ID> --name MY_SECRET_NAME --scopes workers --remote


```

```

✓ Enter a secret value: › ***


🔐 Creating secret... (Name: MY_SECRET_NAME, Value: REDACTED, Scopes: workers, Comment: undefined)

✓ Select an account: › My account

✅ Created secret! (ID: 13bc7498c6374a4e9d13be091c3c65f1)


```

1. In the Cloudflare dashboard, go to the **Secrets Store** page.  
[ Go to **Secrets Store** ](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/secrets-store)
2. Select **Create secret**.
3. Fill in the required fields, choosing _Workers_ as the **Permission scope**. Once the secret is saved, the secret value will no longer be available for viewing.
4. (Optional) Select **Add additional secret** to create more than one secret at a time.
5. Select **Save** to confirm.

You can find and copy the store ID from the [Secrets Store tab ↗](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/secrets-store/) on the dashboard or use the [Wrangler command](/workers/wrangler/commands/#secrets-store-store). Also, make sure your secret `name` does not contain spaces.

Refer to [Secrets Store API](/api/resources/secrets%5Fstore/) for the full API documentation.

Required API token permissions

At least one of the following [token permissions](/fundamentals/api/reference/permissions/)is required:
* `Secrets Store 
Required API token permissions

At least one of the following [token permissions](/fundamentals/api/reference/permissions/)is required:
* `Secrets Store Write`

Create a secret

```

curl "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/$ACCOUNT_ID/secrets_store/stores/$STORE_ID/secrets" \

  --request POST \

  --header "X-Auth-Email: $CLOUDFLARE_EMAIL" \

  --header "X-Auth-Key: $CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY" \

  --json '[

    {

        "name": "<MY_SECRET_NAME>",

        "value": "<SECRET_VALUE>",

        "scopes": [

            "workers"

        ],

        "comment": ""

    },

    {

        "name": "<MY_SECRET_NAME_2>",

        "value": "<SECRET_VALUE>",

        "scopes": [

            "workers"

        ],

        "comment": ""

    }

  ]'


```

Refer to [manage account secrets](/secrets-store/manage-secrets/) for further options.

## 2\. Bind an account secret to your Worker

[Bindings](/workers/runtime-apis/bindings/) allow your Worker to interact with resources on your Cloudflare account.


Consider the steps below to learn how to use values from your account secrets store with [Cloudflare Workers](/workers/).

Note

This is different from Workers [Variables and Secrets](/workers/configuration/secrets/), where you define and manage your secrets on a per-Worker level.

## Before you begin

* If [using the Dashboard](#via-dashboard), make sure you already have a Workers application. Refer to the [Workers get started](/workers/get-started/dashboard/) for guidance.
* You should also have a store created under the **Secrets Store** tab on the Dashboard. The first store in your account is created automatically when a user with [Super Administrator or Secrets Store Admin role](/secrets-store/access-control/) interacts with it.  
   * If no store exists in your account yet and you have the necessary permissions, you can use the [Wrangler command](/workers/wrangler/commands/#secrets-store-store) `secrets-store store create <name> --remote` to create your first store.

Local development mode

This guide assumes you are working in production. To use Secrets Store locally, you must use `secrets-store secret` [Wrangler commands](/workers/wrangler/commands/) without the `--remote` flag.

## 1\. Set up account secrets in Secrets Store

Follow the steps below to create secrets. You must have a [Super Administrator or a Secrets Store Admin role](/secrets-store/access-control/) within your Cloudflare account.

# Changelog

## Cloudflare Secrets Store now available in Beta

Apr 09, 2025 

[ Secrets Store ](/secrets-store/)[ SSL/TLS ](/ssl/) 

Cloudflare Secrets Store is available today in Beta. You can now store, manage, and deploy account level secrets from a secure, centralized platform to your Workers.

![Import repo or choose template](/_astro/secrets-store-landing-page.BQoEWsq8_1OnK0D.webp) 

To spin up your Cloudflare Secrets Store, simply click the new Secrets Store tab [in the dashboard ↗](http://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/secrets-store) or use this Wrangler command:

Terminal window

```

wrangler secrets-store store create <name> --remote


```

The following are supported in the Secrets Store beta:

* Secrets Store UI & API: create your store & create, duplicate, update, scope, and delete a secret
* Workers UI: bind a new or existing account level secret to a Worker and deploy in code
* Wrangler: create your store & create, duplicate, update, scope, and delete a secret
* Account Management UI & API: assign Secrets Store permissions roles & view audit logs for actions taken in Secrets Store core platform

For instructions on how to get started, visit our [developer documentation](/secrets-store/).

<text>
Currently [in beta with a Workers integration ↗](https://blog.cloudflare.com/secrets-store-beta/), [Cloudflare Secrets Store ↗](https://developers.cloudflare.com/secrets-store/) allows you to store, manage, and deploy account level secrets from a secure, centralized platform your [Cloudflare Workers ↗](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/). Now, you can create and deploy **100 secrets per account**. Try it out [in the dashboard ↗](http://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/secrets-store), with [Wrangler ↗](https://developers.cloudflare.com/secrets-store/integrations/workers/), or [via the API ↗](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/secrets%5Fstore/) today.

> AGENT

いい考えですね。現状と Secret Store の比較です。

## 現状: Worker-level Secrets

各シークレットが `wrangler secret put` で **Worker ごと**に管理されている:

```
ingestion Worker:
  - GITHUB_TOKEN
  - OURA_CLIENT_ID / OURA_CLIENT_SECRET
  - LINEAR_API_KEY
  - WITHINGS_CLIENT_ID / WITHINGS_CLIENT_SECRET
```

## Secret Store にすると

**アカウントレベル**で一元管理し、複数 Worker から共有できる:

| 比較項目 | Worker Secrets | Secret Store |
|---------|---------------|-------------|
| スコープ | Worker 単位 | アカウント単位 |
| 共有 | 不可（Worker ごとにコピー） | 複数 Worker で共有可能 |
| 管理 | `wrangler secret put` per Worker | Dashboard / Wrangler / API で一括管理 |
| ローテーション | Worker ごとに更新 | 1箇所更新で全 Worker に反映 |
| 状態 | Beta ではない（GA） | **Open Beta** |
| 上限 | Worker あたり制限なし | **100 secrets/account** |

## このプロジェクトでの恩恵

現状 `ingestion` しかシークレットを使っていないので、恩恵は小さめです。ただ、今後 Worker が増えて同じ API キーを共有するケースが出てくるなら価値があります。

**向いているケース:**
- 複数 Worker で `GITHUB_TOKEN` を使いたい（例: ingestion + 別の分析 Worker）
- キーローテーション時に1箇所だけ変えたい

**今はまだ早いケース:**
- シークレットを使うのが ingestion だけ
- Beta なので本番利用にリスクがある

やるなら `wrangler.jsonc` に `secrets_store_secrets` バインディングを追加する形になります。今すぐ移行しますか？それとも Worker が増えたタイミングで検討しますか？

    66→      service: "oura",
    67→      success: false,
    68→      message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unknown error",
    69→    });
    70→  }
    71→
    72→  try {
    73→    results.push(await runLinearSync(c.env));
    74→  } catch (e) {
    75→    results.push({
    76→      service: "linear",
    77→      success: false,
    78→      message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unknown error",
    79→    });
    80→  }
    81→
    82→  try {
    83→    results.push(await runWithingsSync(c.env));
    84→  } catch (e) {
    85→    results.push({
    86→      service: "withings",
    87→      success: false,
    88→      message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unknown error",
    89→    });
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  return c.json({
    93→    results,
    94→    success: results.every((r) => r.success),
    95→  });
    96→});
    97→
    98→// Health check
    99→app.get("/health", (c) => c.json({ status: "ok" }));
   100→
   101→// Scheduled handler (Cron)
   102→// "0 0 * * *"    → GitHub (1日1回 UTC 0:00 / JST 9:00)
   103→// "0 */12 * * *" → Oura   (12時間毎 UTC 0:00,12:00 / JST 9:00,21:00)
   104→// "0 */6 * * *"  → Linear (6時間毎 UTC 0:00,6:00,12:00,18:00)
   105→const scheduled: ExportedHandlerScheduledHandler<Env> = async (event, env) => {
   106→  console.log("Scheduled sync started:", event.cron);
   107→
   108→  if (event.cron === "0 0 * * *") {
   109→    try {
   110→      const result = await runGitHubSync(env);
   111→      console.log("GitHub sync completed:", result);
   112→    } catch (e) {
   113→      console.error("GitHub sync failed:", e);
   114→    }
   115→  }
   116→
   117→  if (event.cron === "0 */12 * * *") {
   118→    try {
   119→      const result = await runOuraSync(env);
   120→      console.log("Oura sync completed:", result);
   121→    } catch (e) {
   122→      console.error("Oura sync failed:", e);
   123→    }
   124→
   125→    try {
   126→      const result = await runWithingsSync(env);
   127→      console.log("Withings sync completed:", result);
   128→    } catch (e) {
   129→      console.error("Withings sync failed:", e);
   130→    }
   131→  }
   132→
   133→  if (event.cron === "0 */6 * * *") {
   134→    try {
   135→      const result = await runLinearSync(env);
   136→      console.log("Linear sync completed:", result);
   137→    } catch (e) {
   138→      console.error("Linear sync failed:", e);
   139→    }
   140→  }
   141→};
   142→
   143→export default {
   144→  fetch: app.fetch,
   145→  scheduled,
   146→};
   147→
```

    59→// --- GraphQL Client ---
    60→
    61→async function fetchLinearGraphQL<T>(
    62→  query: string,
    63→  variables: Record<string, unknown>,
    64→  apiKey: string
    65→): Promise<T> {
    66→  const res = await fetch("https://api.linear.app/graphql", {
    67→    method: "POST",
    68→    headers: {
    69→      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    70→      Authorization: apiKey,
    71→    },
    72→    body: JSON.stringify({ query, variables }),
    73→  });
    74→
    75→  if (!res.ok) {
    76→    throw new Error(`Linear API error: ${res.status}`);
    77→  }
    78→
    79→  const json = (await res.json()) as { data?: T; errors?: { message: string }[] };
    80→  if (json.errors?.length) {
    81→    throw new Error(`Linear GraphQL error: ${json.errors[0].message}`);
    82→  }
    83→  return json.data as T;
    84→}
    85→
    86→// --- Pagination Helper ---
    87→
    88→async function fetchAllPages<T>(apiKey: string, query: string, rootField: string): Promise<T[]> {
    89→  const results: T[] = [];
    90→  let after: string | null = null;
    91→
    92→  type Connection = Record<string, { nodes: T[]; pageInfo: PageInfo }>;
    93→  do {
    94→    const data: Connection = await fetchLinearGraphQL<Connection>(
    95→      query,
    96→      { first: 50, after },
    97→      apiKey
    98→    );
    99→    const connection = data[rootField];
   100→    results.push(...connection.nodes);
   101→    after = connection.pageInfo.hasNextPage ? connection.pageInfo.endCursor : null;
   102→  } while (after);
   103→
   104→  return results;
   105→}

   108→
   109→const ISSUES_QUERY = `

   111→    issues(first: $first, after: $after, orderBy: updatedAt) {
   112→      nodes {
   113→        id identifier title description
   114→        priority estimate
   115→        state { name type }
   116→        labels { nodes { name } }
   117→        project { name }
   118→        cycle { number }
   119→        assignee { name }
   120→        createdAt updatedAt startedAt completedAt canceledAt
   121→        dueDate
   122→      }
   123→      pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }
   124→    }
   125→  }

   132→        id name state progress
   133→        startDate targetDate
   134→        createdAt updatedAt completedAt
   135→      }
   136→      pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }
   137→    }
   138→  }
   139→`;
   140→
   141→const LABELS_QUERY = `
   142→  query Labels {
   143→    issueLabels(first: 250) {
   144→      nodes { id name color }
   145→    }
   146→  }
   147→`;
   148→

   150→
   151→export async function runSync(env: Env): Promise<SyncResult> {
   152→  const { LINEAR_API_KEY: apiKey, DATA_LAKE: r2, PARQUET_ENCODER: encoder } = env;
   153→
   154→  const synced_at = new Date().toISOString();
   155→
   156→  // 1. Fetch & write issues → linear/issues.parquet (snapshot)
   157→  const issues = await fetchAllPages<LinearIssue>(apiKey, ISSUES_QUERY, "issues");
   158→  const issueRows: LinearIssueRow[] = issues.map((issue) => ({
   159→    id: issue.id,
   160→    identifier: issue.identifier,
   161→    title: issue.title,
   162→    description_length: issue.description?.length ?? 0,
   163→    priority: issue.priority,
   164→    estimate: issue.estimate,
   165→    state_name: issue.state?.name ?? null,
   166→    state_type: issue.state?.type ?? null,
   167→    label_names: JSON.stringify(issue.labels.nodes.map((l) => l.name)),
   168→    project_name: issue.project?.name ?? null,
   169→    cycle_number: issue.cycle?.number ?? null,
   170→    assignee_name: issue.assignee?.name ?? null,
   171→    created_at: issue.createdAt,
   172→    updated_at: issue.updatedAt,
   173→    started_at: issue.startedAt,
   174→    completed_at: issue.completedAt,
   175→    canceled_at: issue.canceledAt,
   176→    due_date: issue.dueDate,
   177→    synced_at,
   178→  }));
   179→  if (issueRows.length > 0) {
   180→    const parquet = await encodeLinearIssue(encoder, issueRows);
   181→    await r2.put("linear/issues.parquet", parquet);
   182→  }
   183→
   184→  // 2. Fetch & write projects → linear/projects.parquet (snapshot)
   185→  const projects = await fetchAllPages<LinearProject>(apiKey, PROJECTS_QUERY, "projects");
   186→  const projectRows: LinearProjectRow[] = projects.map((project) => ({
   187→    id: project.id,

   189→    state: project.state,
   190→    progress: project.progress,
   191→    start_date: project.startDate,

   198→  if (projectRows.length > 0) {

   224→  ).run();

   226→  return {
   227→    service: "linear",

   229→    message: `Synced ${issues.length} issues, ${projects.length} projects, ${labels.length} labels to R2 Parquet`,
   230→    count: issues.length,

   232→}

   236→app.post("/sync", async (c) => {

   249→    stats[key] = obj ? new Date(obj.uploaded).toISOString() : null;
   250→  }
   251→
   252→  const syncState = await c.env.DB.prepare(
   253→    "SELECT last_sync_at FROM sync_state WHERE data_source_id = 'linear'"
   254→  ).first<{ last_sync_at: string | null }>();

   256→  return c.json({ ...stats, last_sync: syncState?.last_sync_at ?? null });

> AGENT

原因がわかりました。**Parquet エンコーディングの問題ではなく、API 認証の問題です。**

| サービス | 状態 | 原因 |
|---------|------|------|
| **Oura** | 成功 | OAuth トークンが有効 |
| **GitHub** | 401 | `GITHUB_TOKEN` が無効 or 未設定 |
| **Linear** | 401 | `LINEAR_API_KEY` が無効 or 未設定 |
| **Withings** | 503 | `WITHINGS_CLIENT_ID/SECRET` が無効 |

Service Binding 経由の Parquet 書き込みは正常に動いています（Oura で実証済み）。GitHub / Linear / Withings のシークレット（API キー）がデプロイ時に失われたか、期限切れの可能性があります。

Cloudflare Dashboard で `ingestion` Worker の Settings > Variables and Secrets を確認して、`GITHUB_TOKEN` と `LINEAR_API_KEY` が設定されているか確認してもらえますか？

   107→async function getValidToken(db: D1Database, env: Env): Promise<string> {
   108→  const row = await db
   109→    .prepare("SELECT access_token, refresh_token, expires_at FROM oauth_tokens WHERE id = 'oura'")
   110→    .first<{ access_token: string; refresh_token: string; expires_at: string }>();
   111→
   112→  if (!row) {
   113→    throw new Error("Oura not authenticated. Visit /oura/auth to connect.");
   114→  }
   115→
   116→  const now = new Date();
   117→  const expiresAt = new Date(row.expires_at);
   118→
   119→  if (now < expiresAt) {
   120→    return row.access_token;
   121→  }
   122→
   123→  // Refresh token
   124→  const res = await fetch(OURA_TOKEN_URL, {
   125→    method: "POST",
   126→    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
   127→    body: new URLSearchParams({
   128→      grant_type: "refresh_token",
   129→      refresh_token: row.refresh_token,
   130→      client_id: env.OURA_CLIENT_ID,
   131→      client_secret: env.OURA_CLIENT_SECRET,
   132→    }),
   133→  });
   134→
   135→  if (!res.ok) {
   136→    const text = await res.text();
   137→    throw new Error(`Oura token refresh failed: ${res.status} ${text}`);
   138→  }
   139→
   140→  const token=[REDACTED] = await res.json();
   141→  const newExpiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + token.expires_in * 1000).toISOString();
   142→
   143→  await db
   144→    .prepare(
   145→      `UPDATE oauth_tokens SET
   146→        access_token = ?, refresh_token = ?, expires_at = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')
   147→       WHERE id = 'oura'`
   148→    )
   149→    .bind(token.access_token, token.refresh_token, newExpiresAt)
   150→    .run();
   151→
   152→  return token.access_token;
   153→}
   154→
   155→// ============================================
   156→// API Client
   157→// ============================================
   158→
   159→async function fetchOura<T>(
   160→  path: string,
   161→  token: string,
   162→  params?: Record<string, string>
   163→): Promise<OuraResponse<T>> {
   164→  const url = new URL(`${OURA_API_BASE}${path}`);
   165→  if (params) {
   166→    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
   167→      url.searchParams.set(k, v);
   168→    }
   169→  }
   170→
   171→  const res = await fetch(url.toString(), {
   172→    headers: {
   173→      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
   174→      "User-Agent": "ingestion-worker",
   175→    },
   176→  });
   177→
   178→  if (res.status === 429) {
   179→    throw new Error("Oura API rate limit exceeded");
   180→  }
   181→  if (res.status === 401) {
   182→    throw new Error("Oura API unauthorized - token may be expired");
   183→  }
   184→  if (!res.ok) {
   185→    const body = await res.text();
   186→    const truncated = body.length > 500 ? `${body.slice(0, 500)}...(truncated)` : body;
   187→    throw new Error(`Oura API error: ${res.status} - ${truncated || "no response body"}`);
   188→  }
   189→
   190→  return res.json();
   191→}
   192→
   193→async function fetchAllPages<T>(
   194→  path: string,
   195→  token: string,
   196→  params: Record<string, string>
   197→): Promise<T[]> {
   198→  const allData: T[] = [];
   199→  let nextToken: string | undefined;
   200→
   201→  do {
   202→    const reqParams = { ...params };
   203→    if (nextToken) {
   204→      reqParams.next_token = nextToken;
   205→    }
   206→
   207→    const response = await fetchOura<T>(path, token, reqParams);
   208→    allData.push(...response.data);
   209→    nextToken = response.next_token;
   210→  } while (nextToken);
   211→
   212→  return allData;
   213→}
   214→
   215→// ============================================
   216→// Chunking & Grouping Utilities
   217→// ============================================
   218→
   219→function splitIntoMonthlyChunks(
   220→  startDate: string,
   221→  endDate: string
   222→): Array<{ start: string; end: string }> {
   223→  const chunks: Array<{ start: string; end: string }> = [];
   224→  let current = new Date(`${startDate}T00:00:00Z`);
   225→  const end = new Date(`${endDate}T00:00:00Z`);
   226→
   227→  while (current <= end) {
   228→    const chunkEnd = new Date(current);
   229→    chunkEnd.setUTCMonth(chunkEnd.getUTCMonth() + 1);
   230→    chunkEnd.setUTCDate(0); // last day of current month
   231→    const effectiveEnd = chunkEnd > end ? end : chunkEnd;
   232→    chunks.push({
   233→      start: current.toISOString().split("T")[0],
   234→      end: effectiveEnd.toISOString().split("T")[0],
   235→    });
   236→    current = new Date(effectiveEnd);
   237→    current.setUTCDate(current.getUTCDate() + 1);
   238→  }
   239→  return chunks;
   240→}
   241→
   242→function groupByDay<T>(items: T[], getDayFn: (item: T) => string): Map<string, T[]> {
   243→  const map = new Map<string, T[]>();
   244→  for (const item of items) {
   245→    const day = getDayFn(item);
   246→    const arr = map.get(day) ?? [];
   247→    arr.push(item);
   248→    map.set(day, arr);
   249→  }
   250→  return map;
   251→}
   252→
   253→async function writeParquetToR2(
   254→  r2: R2Bucket,
   255→  tableName: string,
   256→  day: string,
   257→  data: Uint8Array
   258→): Promise<void> {
   259→  const key = `oura/${tableName}/${day}.parquet`;
   260→  await r2.put(key, data);
   261→}
   262→
   263→function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
   264→  return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
   265→}

   271→async function syncDailySleep(
   272→  r2: R2Bucket,
   273→  encoder: Fetcher,
   274→  token: string,
   275→  startDate: string,
   276→  endDate: string
   277→): Promise<number> {
   278→  const data = await fetchAllPages<OuraDailySleep>("/v2/usercollection/daily_sleep", token, {
   279→    start_date: startDate,
   280→    end_date: endDate,
   281→  });
   282→
   283→  if (data.length === 0) return 0;
   284→
   285→  const synced_at = new Date().toISOString();
   286→  const grouped = groupByDay(data, (item) => item.day);
   287→
   288→  for (const [day, items] of grouped) {
   289→    const rows: DailySleepRow[] = items.map((item) => ({
   290→      day: item.day,
   291→      score: item.score ?? null,
   292→      deep_sleep: item.contributors?.deep_sleep ?? null,
   293→      efficiency: item.contributors?.efficiency ?? null,
   294→      latency: item.contributors?.latency ?? null,
   295→      rem_sleep: item.contributors?.rem_sleep ?? null,
   296→      restfulness: item.contributors?.restfulness ?? null,
   297→      timing: item.contributors?.timing ?? null,
   298→      total_sleep: item.contributors?.total_sleep ?? null,
   299→      timestamp: item.timestamp,
   300→      synced_at,
   301→    }));
   302→    const parquet = await encodeDailySleep(encoder, rows);
   303→    await writeParquetToR2(r2, "daily_sleep", day, parquet);
   304→  }
   305→
   306→  return data.length;
   307→}
